Introducing Robert Strunk, Coachella Valley Regional Organizer!
Born in the Bay Area and raised near Seattle, WA, Robert spent years traveling Northern and Southern California; now, he calls Palm Springs home.
Robert's journey into organizing and activism began in the summer of 2016 with the rise of Donald Trump as the Republican nominee. He saw an immediate need to take action and embraced the role of an organizer.
Robert was proud to join the California Democratic Party in 2017 as an elected delegate representing Humboldt County, marking a pivotal step in his commitment to bringing change. He is dedicated to safeguarding democracy, championing women's rights nationwide, and advocating for comprehensive immigration reform.
As the Coachella Valley Regional Organizer, he is focused on growing our democratic bench in California, working to elect our CADEM-endorsed candidates in battleground seats across the state.
Robert is excited to collaborate with activists and partners in Southern California to support Will Rollins' congressional campaign for CA-41.

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=780dc9f40ff145819a686242eec34a87&_e=gnduQBL_YEVqYq-FF1tYnmOZjIS1L0a_7riEe3DPR-bS6G3VnHUANmALzLP5yVL--Dq6ogvcMINS0ZsQFLsY1f2UQvNoUU7TUufdZRXSIe1rjyfxdQ7AaBVBT8XrfV6FCCrjo3ymiDgbE8UryuGMaM3saOCp1TPFVp4fq_sjSGFP5y-qtd2OBdzf03d2cEC6SeEXisXg9hhuxb8cNjE9yFU_n1PMHMiQQH3lH1y8PFA4-EVf4eJxcZzj_UMye0sLlHbz0F5ow3itaxfm6p22Z9NWEXwF18qtKgvF2FmxSwoqBSFO6hVZ4ymEtm8X1-cEIny85l8WX9B_NfpmTGa7eFutS-XEC_OfTWpCtjRJcAqw5dIVKnzeL5f1EZLq53eQ5LTNl9wYvaYBTuQVZDEWuw%3D%3D) **

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. subject: Fighting for liberation, from the Capitol steps to the concert stage / Luchando por la liberación, desde los pasos del Capitolio hasta la escena del concierto
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Speaking truth to power against Gov. Abbott's racist SB4
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Damaris%20with%20fist%20raised%20SB4.png]
Hundreds of Texans from all across the state came together at the Texas Capitol this past Saturday to rally and make clear that we will NOT be intimidated by Gov. Greg Abbott's latest white nationalist law, SB4.
Help our movement fight this law digitally: LIKE and SHARE this fiery TikTok of TOP organizer Damaris Gonzalez speaking out against SB4.
Pushed by far-right Texas legislators, SB4 was signed into law by Gov. Abbott last year, and was slated to take effect on March 5, yet is currently on hold after a last-minute Supreme Court decision. With SB4, Abbott and his enablers are pandering to white nationalists and right-wing extremists by enacting dangerous policy that only seeks to sow fear in our immigrant communities.
SB4 is the most extreme anti-immigrant law our state has passed in modern times . It overrides national immigration law, violates the Constitution, and gives local law enforcement and certain judges the power to DEPORT PEOPLE WITHOUT DUE PROCESS.
For more information on how you can join TOP's fight against this heinous law, call or text Damaris at 832-774-7704.
🎟️ RSVP NOW 🎟️
'House Everyone/Vivienda Para Todos' Cultural Caravan comes through TX this week
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/House%20Everyone%20flyer.jpg]
THIS WEEK, we're raising the roof for affordable green social housing for ALL in the Lone Star State! 🏡
We’re joining our national movement homies at Center for Popular Democracy (CPD) and VOCAL-TX as we co-host the Cultural Caravan Festival with some of the most radical voices in Hip-Hop today.
Our San Antonio show took place on Tuesday, so be sure to join us in Austin (March 14) and Houston (March 17) for performances featuring Dead Prez , Kemba , and many other fantastic, up-and-coming artists. Follow CPD on Instagram for the concert livestream [https://www.instagram.com/popdemoc/] , and check out our #HouseEveryOne caravan updates as the artists travel the state demanding real housing solutions for our communities. Click the links below for more details and to RSVP!
Austin [https://www.mobilize.us/cpda/event/610867/] -- March 14
Houston [https://www.mobilize.us/cpda/event/610870/] -- March 17
For more information about this cultural caravan, email TK at tkoontz@organizetexas.org [tkoontz@organizetexas.org] .
A new TOP Education Fund board member joins Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/1.jpg]
Congratulations to our new TOP board member Andrea Osorio of San Antonio.
From helping set organizational priorities to keeping us true to our values, TOP and TOP Education Fund's board members are deeply passionate about our work, as well as getting us closer to the #TexasForAll that everyday Texans deserve.
A mother, wife, daughter, cousin, and friend residing in San Antonio, Andrea believes a better, more just world is possible, but only if we fight for it. Andrea enjoys spending quality time with her family, as well as reading up on current events happening across the world and in her community. As a Bexar County TOP member, she was proud to be at the forefront of the organization's win to start an enhanced library card program in San Antonio, an effort initiated by TOP's immigration justice campaign.
TOP Tips: Apply and help us build a #TexasForAll
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/We%20are%20hiring%20-%20English.png]
If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/] . Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you may have in min! Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply.

Estamos hablando en contra de la ley SB4 del gobernador Abbott

Cientos de tejanos de todo el estado se reunieron en el Capitolio de Texas este sábado para manifestarse y dejar en claro que NO nos dejaremos intimidar por la última ley nacionalista blanca del gobernador Greg Abbott, SB4.

La SB4 es la ley antiinmigrante más extrema que nuestro estado ha aprobado en los tiempos modernos. Anula la ley de inmigración nacional, viola la Constitución y otorga a las autoridades locales y a ciertos jueces el poder de DEPORTAR A PERSONAS SIN EL DEBIDO PROCESO.

Siga a CPD en su página de Instagram para ver la transmisión en vivo del concierto [http://www.instagram.com/popdemoc/] y vea las actualizaciones de nuestra caravana #HouseEveryOne mientras los artistas viajan por el estado exigiendo soluciones de vivienda reales para nuestras comunidades. ¡Haga clic en los enlaces a continuación para obtener más detalles y confirmar su asistencia!
Austin [http://www.mobilize.us/cpda/event/610867/] – 14 de marzo

Un nuevo miembro de la junta directiva del TOP Education Fund se une al Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/1.jpg]
Felicitaciones a nuestra nueva miembro de la junta directiva de TOP, Andrea Osorio de San Antonio.
Desde ayudar a establecer prioridades organizacionales hasta mantenernos fieles a nuestros valores, los miembros de la junta directiva de TOP y TOP Education Fund sienten una profunda pasión por nuestro trabajo, además de acercarnos al #TexasParaTodos que los tejanos de todos los días merecen.
Andrea, madre, esposa, hija, prima y amiga que reside en San Antonio, cree que un mundo mejor y más justo es posible, pero solo si luchamos por él. Andrea disfruta pasar tiempo de calidad con su familia, además de leer sobre los acontecimientos actuales que suceden en todo el mundo y en su comunidad. Como miembro de TOP del condado de Bexar, está orgullosa de estar a la vanguardia de la victoria de la organización para iniciar un programa de las tarjetas mejoradas de la biblioteca en San Antonio, un esfuerzo iniciado por la campaña de justicia de inmigración de TOP.

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31757%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AZwaBvUSkPpBdKBfanB0rw&sysid=1)

**[Please give a crucial $25, $50, $100, or more IMMEDIATELY to fully fund my critical, class action lawsuits and hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31759%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bg0atRDEQDxZaH%2f8dGvptw&sysid=1)**

Over a year ago, I wrote an urgent email to patriots just like you about what’s really happening to January 6 Peaceful Protesters in the Washington, DC jail.

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba ...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Their letter reads like an appeal from dissidents in the Soviet Union.

Here are just a few examples of what they’re enduring (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* **Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy****through a 4 inch by 10 inch window of cold metal doors**
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

But there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water, and keep them from going to court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for years ... in AMERICA.

**They conclude their letter by pleading to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where the Taliban and Islamic terrorists get better treatment!**

This can’t go on.

**That’s why I’ve filed crucial lawsuits to FREE January 6 peaceful protesters. Including a critical new lawsuit that PROVES the FBI and other agencies carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE on January 6 patriots. That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials MUST STOP.**

I’m Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 41 years.

You’ve seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I’m the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with this critically important case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

**[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $$25, $50, $100, or even more.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31750%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=crLEwpuwkbWGhA97mArItg&sysid=1)**

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.

**P.S. Patriot, innocent Americans are begging for water in the Washington, DC jail. These innocent men and women are being tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

**[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $25, $50, $100, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Every dollar counts.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31751%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=llGQXffy3nmYs8iYvkGmfQ&sysid=1)**

| | Friend, It's official. We are through game one of the double header. The voters have spoken, and they chose me to be the Republican candidate for Senate in California. name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The Power of the Cross
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWgNcpniNM

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWgNcpniNM

Hello
Friend,

The cross
of Jesus Christ stands at the center of our faith. It is the
symbol not just of a religion but of the ultimate sacrifice and
love displayed by Jesus Christ for humanity.

The cross
stands as a reminder of the immense love of God, who sent His
only Son to bear the burden of our sins. Through His sacrifice,
Jesus provided a path to redemption and eternal life for all who
believe in Him.

In
moments of hardship and uncertainty, we, as believers, can find
strength in the shadow of the cross. It stands as a promise of
salvation and the assurance of God's unfailing grace.

The power
of the cross lies in its ability to transform lives and reconcile
humanity with God. It is the ultimate symbol of victory-victory
over sin and death. It offers forgiveness and restoration to all
who embrace its message.

This
beautiful full-color 96-page large print "coffee-table style"
book is filled with imagery from the Holy Land as well as
photographic depictions of key Scriptural events. It can be used
as a daily devotional or as a timeless reference resource about
the events of Jesus' final week on earth.

A copy of
The Power of the Cross is our gift to anyone who supports the
ministry of Pathway to Victory. By making a secure, generous
donation to our work of evangelism and Bible teaching, you are
helping many people around the world experience the power of the
cross and its message of hope and forgiveness.

Please consider
supporting our mission of helping people know Jesus and
understand the Bible. If you can help, here is a link to make
your secure donation and order your copy of The Power of the
Cross: https://secure.ptv.org/the_power_of_the_cross

Our time for sharing
the message of Jesus and the power of the cross grows shorter
every day.

Let's make the most
of it by partnering together!

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress
Senior Pastor, First
Baptist Dallas

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

## Judge Drops Six Counts Against Trump
The judge overseeing former President Trump's election interference case in Georgia has [dropped six](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7oiWZY1DQXFNulx7pbWGxeGEjUW4RPf3T3n1K0fTjObPfblzLvnYfvMuvqe6cOj5JYtRmhTSQmP0SQTFjOL1rIHQGKfHh1-ZJ5rcyoAuWZ4x4MQRDF6REjszZo-ABEYTuMlqd2GLfBVLkwYDNsJAIDH32i5_az76Q1L5X1_SLqHuY_GP3s_nYH4NeBvwxuch7-dHfaD1HIoMeNukti2zkiKh53qofHRpSZocQRQCgurt334qsgKrvQacZu0CAWkDaRYrvFoXQxybj-c7l5Kfdh4Itp1z-S7pP375CgAA__8lN2H_) of the case's original thirteen counts. Judge Scott McAfee said the counts failed to provide enough detail of the alleged crimes and weren't specific enough to allow President Trump and his 18 co-defendants to prepare adequately. The [dropped counts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPozAQRn-N6YzGY8dA4eIaulx7JXLsASYyGGEn3P77Vbbe5qs-6T29f_fp7jnxvvz1G7k658mHym-atFRGoplME91MhKQbcqpTYFDrQTWri4SDNbE3-NCD13MkeMyhn32IvepsbNghoAGtDAw3q4bWW_Q9WXNToMFGEAYocs1n-8y815Xm9JXfdLYhb01ya61HEfqPwFHgeF1Xe-TElUP-HASOO11F4PihCBxBCxzVZ56vuJCsuRQqsvB_GVZ_LlQk77Ker-2QC-VzYS95jxzqRnuVAMrYTunmdPG4OCUuthMGls1z-jGqv_b5DgAA___A-2Wu) were related to President Trump allegedly coercing a public officer into violating his oath. Seven counts against Trump remain, and the fate of Fulton County DA Fani Willis is still undecided. "_The Court made the correct legal decision to grant the special demurrers and quash important counts of the indictment brought by DA Fani Willis_ ," [said Trump attorney](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GO6yAQAL8GukSwLGAKite4y2uvtAisY044RPaerfv7k3LtlaMpRvNxm26ptvp8_E8rRZ77lDLXgyZz0XgBnFCWOBMBGUlRe60QjAlaLjHPd1O8cxa9HkpKRaO7-wTKYQ42Z1kjKEBlNKpgnQ7X5CAN5NBqZZQrSqCiUrlv189en7zQ3L77Qds191W2uDC_dmH-CRgFjHxW5l8nYNyZDtpT6ecbEn_tAkbtnQ9WoR2CG0IYAEBusbzO2lrdnReoHmuq7R3gP3d_AgAA__9BX1OS) Steve Sadow.
## House Votes to Force TikTok Sale or Ban
The House voted overwhelmingly on Wednesday to force China-based ByteDance [to sell the TikTok social media platform](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFzhCAQRn8NdDiwIJ4FRRq7S5vSWXE9N8fJjZAz-fcZU6f5mm_mvXkf1_GKnHi7veODQl3yiLHyi0arjFPgRifnsBABWUnBdEY7sLY3cg0Ro4-W-qmLbbtcpmk2HRrvPVxca2MnOYAGp61xum-96Rv0gBfyrjXaaj9r4TTNXPPefGbe6kpL-skv2puYHzKFtdZnEfZNwCBgOI6jwW_O5XwFDCdbwKCtgMGcs-avQuqJpVBRle8139WEmyqYSE2ckoorbyj3MD8PTomL74TTtwdy-jPWf_t_AwAA__8UqFpa) or face a ban in the U.S. The vote was 352-65. The bill moves now to the Senate, where [its future is uncertain](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQgOGnwR3RMGDnKFxc4y7XXmlhMw6zIcaCSaK8_Spbb_0Vv_T_v8yXwJn3679wp1G2ModV-Emz1cZpdLPr4rgRIdmORnM24NBab7o0Ei6mJ089QvAQIwRzXlbrAXrvcVg6HhHQgTUOfD8YfwoDhj80uN6AhSGCckCRpdTTV-FdEm35XZ5UT2u5d3lMIkdT9q_CSeEkiRLn_DGF006vlkmEavsYrWkvuVzfCifXW0Bj9FGptUclvTw4x6Z51432IKTDJlR1Ko9G-gitUdPCNyk3vXDOCqeujvF4cc7chrNycL0H_il38uuj7wAAAP__kqto-g). A bipartisan group of senators back it, claiming it's spyware for China's government, but others, including Sen. Rand Paul, think it's an unconstitutional infringement on the First Amendment. President Biden has said he would sign the bill, which calls for a sale within 165 days. TikTok has more than 150 million American users, but it's already banned from use on government-issued devices.
## List: World's Most Valuable Sports Franchises
Visual Capitalist put together [an infographic](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvwyAQRn-N2bDgIDgZGLpkS9eO1oHPyVU4WOZiq_--SufO3ye9975u4w258PP-iQtFmeuIWXin0WnrNfjRqynOREBOUbSDNR6cu1j1iENCmN2QPVpMLuN5NiYngHNINruQFEcw4I2z3lxOwV56DIBnCv5kjTNhMp03NLHUrf-u_JQHzeWn7rT1uS6qxIfI2jr30cG1g-txHP3O7YUl48qChZu8j--pbmVqeqlN9I7lhamQbmvdpGkhXJp-i3RwVVuc1oNL4RaGzpv7glz-aPJv-28AAAD___TlW7A) displaying the priciest sports franchises in the world, and America (specifically, the NFL) dominates the list.

Nine of the top 15 are NFL teams, led by the Dallas Cowboys. Jerry Jones purchased the team for $150 million in 1989, and it's appreciated to $9 billion. The New York Yankees are the only baseball team to crack the list, scoring second place with a $7 billion valuation. The NBA has three teams [on the list](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvwyAQRn-N2bDgIDgZGLpkS9eO1oHPyVU4WOZiq_--SufO3ye9975u4w258PP-iQtFmeuIWXin0WnrNfjRqynOREBOUbSDNR6cu1j1iENCmN2QPVpMLuN5NiYngHNINruQFEcw4I2z3lxOwV56DIBnCv5kjTNhMp03NLHUrf-u_JQHzeWn7rT1uS6qxIfI2jr30cG1g-txHP3O7YUl48qChZu8j--pbmVqeqlN9I7lhamQbmvdpGkhXJp-i3RwVVuc1oNL4RaGzpv7glz-aPJv-28AAAD___TlW7A), and only two non-American clubs made the cut, both soccer teams: _Real Madrid_ in Spain and _Manchester United _in England.

I don’t mince words because the reality for too many Americans is harsh and dark. **Our wages are shit while the powerful sit in their mansions, their boats, and their fancy cars and ignore us.** If you are ready to join the class struggle and help me be the voice of the voiceless in the Senate, I need your help. [**Will you chip in $15, $30, or anything you can today?**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktSBoDFFM1jt4Y8v714aO4Stsy_rPLuXAfIAogQLrdjj0&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=031424_video_resend&n=5)**** And when I say the voiceless, I don’t mean just every West Virginian, American, and all who call this country a home. I also mean Palestinian civilians whom our corporate media, political elites, and our members of Congress have tried to dehumanize completely. Just yesterday, the U.S. Senate shamelessly approved $14 billion in military aid to Israel to continue the ongoing genocide...using our taxes. American politics affects the lives of people far beyond our borders. The same moneyed interests that don’t want our wages to increase, that deny us universal health care, that destroy our environment, and that incarcerate us are behind our derailed foreign policy that destabilizes other countries and entire regions and brings primarily black and brown communities famine, disease, and despair. [**I****f you want a Senator whose positions are deeply rooted in human rights—domestically and abroad****—join our campaign today.**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktSBoDFFM1jt4Y8v714aO4Stsy_rPLuXAfIAogQLrdjj0&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=031424_video_resend&n=6) Thank you, Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) Candidate, U.S. Senate

| | | Fellow American, I just got out of a meeting with my campaign manager, and I have some hard news: **We have to raise $10,000 by MIDNIGHT TOMORROW NIGHT if we’re going to meet our mid-month goal.**

Friend, it might sound silly, but today is March 14 (_aka 3/14_), so that means my family is celebrating Pi Day! Of course this day is really about pi, not _pies_ , but we'll jump at any excuse to convince my daughter Siena to bake a pie for us. She's an incredibly talented baker and her pies are legendary in the Mucarsel-Powell household.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80934565/460871939/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&express_lane=true&amount=3.14&refcode=jtk915-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWYzMmYwZWYtMGRlMi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=paeylCF0GvTyJVwDsvz5EeU_cdiwFMKO6XWMyqptlNs=)
**Baking with my daughter is one of my most cherished family traditions. But Siena's pies aren't the only sweet treat that has a special meaning to our family.**
You see, when I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. Those early days were hard for all of us. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small one room apartment.
**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the brighter, better future that we could only dream of before became reality.
We moved out of that one room apartment. I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now I'm running for the United States Senate.
I have a sweet tooth, so I'd be a doughnut fan regardless, but I've never forgotten that I have that little shop to thank for so much that I hold dear — from my beautiful children (and Siena's irresistible pies) to this campaign for Senate. **Doughnuts taught me how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign this November._**

**Thank you!**
It took ten years, but last week we settled our 2014 Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. State Department that sought then-Secretary of State Hillary Clinton's emails regarding the Benghazi attack.
This is the lawsuit that forced the Obama administration to admit to Hillary Clinton's hidden classified and other government emails in 2015... _and that broke open the dam of information about her emails that led directly to her defeat in 2016_!
The American people owe Judicial Watch an enormous debt of thanks...and [I ask for your support today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67458&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) so we can keep doing the long, hard, and expensive work of breaking through government secrecy and demanding accountability from the corupt and powerful!

---
| | It’s been an action-packed few weeks here in Jersey! I joined – and was grateful to receive endorsements from – the Bergen and Sussex County Democratic Committee Conventions, attended the State of the Union, and went to **some of the best St. Patrick’s Day celebrations Jersey has to offer!**

Here we are at the Sussex County Convention, where I was introduced and nominated by my good friend and veteran, Harry Kaplan. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80942260/460893149/1809543647?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20240314_FR_WeeklyUpdates_0_3MO_Josh_NA_NA_updates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZmY5YjdkZC0xNWUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nDV6qY5YbtYds2Y9dLdZmCAsQvZDhhBZBNiejtrjEqU=) Saw lots of friends and familiar faces at the Bergen County Convention (here with the hardworking men and women at ATU)! Grateful to Chairman Paul Juliano. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80942261/460893150/1809543647?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20240314_FR_WeeklyUpdates_0_3MO_Josh_NA_NA_updates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZmY5YjdkZC0xNWUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nDV6qY5YbtYds2Y9dLdZmCAsQvZDhhBZBNiejtrjEqU=) And, we went to St. Patrick's Day celebrations across the state...

You know it instinctively as someone who has seen the results of the last several elections.
You know it because of all of the outside spending that will happen and all of the visits from presidential candidates that are sure to come.

name: Scott Spector
subject: Tough call
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| It wasn’t easy, but I thought you should know about this.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2225%2E35263%2Eue549B)
Hi team — It’s Scott, Tammy’s campaign manager. I made a difficult decision, and I thought you should know about it. As you may know, Republican megamillionaire Eric Hovde recently announced his Senate campaign to flip Tammy’s seat red. And in just one week, **our opponent flooded $2.5 million into Wisconsin to go up with self-funded TV and digital ads — several weeks before our campaign planned to launch ads of our own.** Look, whoever has more resources to spend on TV will likely win this election. That means we can't let Hovde and his right-wing allies control the narrative. We need to make sure voters know the truth now. After talking it through with Tammy and the team, we decided to increase our March advertising budget to go up with our own ads as soon as possible. The money wasn’t in the budget, but I gave the green light anyway. I took a big risk here. There’s no doubt about it. But I was willing to bet that if I reached out and told the truth, our grassroots supporters would come through to help fill this unexpected hole in our budget. That’s the only way we can keep pace with the $20 million Hovde plans to spend. **[So, can I count on you to pitch in to Tammy’s reelection campaign today? **Statement from James Judge (R-FL) on the Ban TikTok act:**
“First and foremost, I am strongly opposed to H.R. 7521, the “ban TikTok” act.
I stand WITH Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY), Rep. Andy Biggs (R-AZ), Rep. Matt Gaetz (R-FL), Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R-GA), and AGAINST Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL) and Rep. Kathy Castor (D-FL) who once again joined hands and worked together by cosponsoring legislation to unconstitutionally expand the federal government’s role and overreach.
If this bill passes the Senate and is signed into law, this bill would grant the president of the United States dangerous new authority to arbitrarily decide if a social media outlet or website is a “threat” and the president alone would be able to determine whether or not a website should be censored. Working with Big Tech to censor Americans or online applications is nothing new for Bilirakis as he has openly advocated for Big Tech and social media outlets like Facebook to censor Americans’ speech. Furthermore, it’s not surprising to see Bilirakis work to take out a competitor of Facebook and Instagram, since he has been repeatedly funded by corporate contributions from TikTok’s direct competitor, Meta/Facebook.
We do not need a more oppressive and expanded federal government, rather, we need less of the nanny state federal government and more personal accountability.
Our right to freedom of speech and the ability to express ourselves freely is a right guaranteed by God, as enshrined in the First Amendment of the Bill of Rights. The rights laid out in our Bill of Rights are granted to us from God, not government. Those rights are absolute and should never be up for debate. Anything that comes close to stripping those rights should be strongly opposed.”

Respectfully,
James P. Judge
_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

| | **I am grateful to share my latest endorsement with you: the Newtown Action Alliance.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80950130/460914767/1596212816?refcode=2024-03-14-newtown&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=f7159786-1fe2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzE1OTc4Ni0xZmUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GVp4uPQSCcNujcnuObOKGTK29-7tYk8eqPep56F9_V0=)** The Newtown Action Alliance, established by residents of Newtown following the tragic Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in 2012, aims to combat gun violence through advocacy and legislative action. The alliance includes advocates, families of victims, and survivors of gun violence from across the country and their advocacy seeks to translate their tragedies into meaningful change through smarter, safer gun laws, and fostering cultural shifts. **At the time of writing this, the United States has already endured 75 mass shootings in 2024, and there have been 225 reported shootings in the last 72 hours alone.** Gun violence is a public health crisis, and I am grateful to Newtown Action Alliance for their work on curbing the epidemic, and will continue to do everything I can to stop the violence. **From Columbine to Sandy Hook to Parkland to Uvalde — and far too many others — our classrooms have become the scene of incomprehensible devastation too many times, as have our theaters, our concerts, our grocery stores, even our places of worship.** Last June, I supported, and Congress passed, the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the first major legislation on gun safety since 1994. The bill contained a set of reforms that are both meaningful enough to make a difference but modest enough to overcome the filibuster. This legislation:
* enhances background checks for 18- to 21-year-old gun buyers;
* closes the so-called boyfriend loophole and further restricts gun ownership for domestic violence offenders who are not married to their partners;
* creates financial incentives for states to adopt red-flag laws that allow police or relatives and acquaintances to petition courts to order the removal of a gun if the individual is deemed dangerous; and
* funds school safety and youth mental health programs.

**While these reforms, known as the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, do not go as far as many – including me – would prefer, they are a step in the right direction, and will save lives.** Other sensible, pragmatic steps that Congress can take – which I have voted for and which are supported by strong majorities of Americans – include:
* establishing universal background checks to keep guns out of the hands of criminals;
* banning large-capacity magazines and bump stocks to reduce the lethality of weapons;
* requiring safe storage to keep guns out of the hands of children; and
* raising the legal age for buying semiautomatic rifles to 21, which would have prevented the shootings in Buffalo and Uvalde.

clean_body: CW: gun violence | | | | I am grateful to share my latest endorsement with you: the Newtown Action Alliance. = The Newtown Action Alliance, established by residents of Newtown following the tragic Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in 2012, aims to combat gun violence through advocacy and legislative action. The alliance includes advocates, families of victims, and survivors of gun violence from across the country and their advocacy seeks to translate their tragedies into meaningful change through smarter, safer gun laws, and fostering cultural shifts. At the time of writing this, the United States has already endured 75 mass shootings in 2024, and there have been 225 reported shootings in the last 72 hours alone. Gun violence is a public health crisis, and I am grateful to Newtown Action Alliance for their work on curbing the epidemic, and will continue to do everything I can to stop the violence. From Columbine to Sandy Hook to Parkland to Uvalde — and far too many others — our classrooms have become the scene of incomprehensible devastation too many times, as have our theaters, our concerts, our grocery stores, even our places of worship. Last June, I supported, and Congress passed, the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the first major legislation on gun safety since 1994. The bill contained a set of reforms that are both meaningful enough to make a difference but modest enough to overcome the filibuster. This legislation: enhances background checks for 18- to 21-year-old gun buyers; closes the so-called boyfriend loophole and further restricts gun ownership for domestic violence offenders who are not married to their partners; creates financial incentives for states to adopt red-flag laws that allow police or relatives and acquaintances to petition courts to order the removal of a gun if the individual is deemed dangerous; and funds school safety and youth mental health programs. While these reforms, known as the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, do not go as far as many – including me – would prefer, they are a step in the right direction, and will save lives. Other sensible, pragmatic steps that Congress can take – which I have voted for and which are supported by strong majorities of Americans – include: establishing universal background checks to keep guns out of the hands of criminals; banning large-capacity magazines and bump stocks to reduce the lethality of weapons; requiring safe storage to keep guns out of the hands of children; and raising the legal age for buying semiautomatic rifles to 21, which would have prevented the shootings in Buffalo and Uvalde. There is so much work to be done on this issue, and I, alongside Newtown Action Alliance, will never let up on creating safer communities for our families. | | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

When we ask you for donations, we don’t stash it away. We don’t spend it on frivolous things. We use it to support our mission
#
Derek: We’re opening up a new front in the fight to get support passed for Ukraine.
We rolled out our newest ad yesterday, **[Pointe du Hoc.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=1&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)** It’s going to be running every day on FOX and Friends for the next week.
That means our ad is going to be playing on Trump’s favorite morning show. The show every Republican in Washington watches while they drink their coffee. The show that sets the agenda for the day for the entire party.
Our ad — pushing the GOP to back support for Ukraine, using the words of one of their most cherished figures. Ronald Reagan.
**[Watch it here, and chip in a few dollars to keep it on the air if you can.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=2&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)**
| [WATCH THE AD](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=3&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)
---
But that’s not all.
Yesterday VoteVets was on Capitol Hill with our supporters, Members of Congress, Senators, Alex Vindman, and American Veterans who fought in Ukraine. All with the same message:
Passing aid for Ukraine is essential to our own national security. Get it done.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=4&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)
We also put our new ad, Pointe du Hoc, on a mobile billboard, a big truck with TV screens on all sides, and drove that around Capitol Hill all day.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=5&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)
And at the end of the day, we broadcast Pointe du Hoc on the RNC itself.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=6&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)
When we ask you for donations, we don’t stash it away. We don’t spend it on frivolous things. We use it to support our mission. And right now, one of the most important things we can do to protect our country and defend democracy is to ensure Ukraine gets the help they need.
We’re proud of the work we do, and we hope you are, too.
You help make it happen.
**[So if you can, chip in today and help us continue this work. We’re committed to this fight, but we can’t do it without you.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-mar24-PDH.dZU0Ya&refcode=em240314-1-30&t=7&akid=24978%2E3013755%2EKJTsKe)

As you know, after being a first-hand witness to his endless barrage of shocking words and divisive behavior when I opposed him in the 2016 presidential campaign, I was resolved never to support a candidate like him. I may have paid a heavy price politically for that decision, but it's not one that I've ever regretted because it simply came down to what I thought was best for America. And, in the long run, what was best for conservative Republican values.

You know my track record. I've been in the trenches fighting for those values for more than forty years and I cherish them deeply. As a well-known “budget hawk” during my 18 years in Congress, I chaired the U.S. House Budget Committee and spent much of my time working to achieve the first balanced federal budget in decades. (And the last balanced budget anyone’s been able to achieve ever since!) Supporting pro-growth policies and fiscal restraint used to be critical components of what it meant to be a Republican.
---
---
As governor of Ohio, I continued to champion conservative principles such as fiscal restraint, removing burdensome regulations that were standing in the way of job creation, and cutting taxes to help create a better business climate. It was a winning formula as we created approximately 500,000 new private-sector jobs, while not leaving anyone behind.
---
---
It seems that for many in politics today, while they call themselves Republicans, their policies are not consistent with the conservative values of traditional Republicans.
* _Why have we become the party that enables a toxic and divisive figure like Trump or his enablers in Congress?
_
* _Why do we not have any kind of hopeful vision for the future of America?
_
* _Why are we retreating from our international alliances?
_
* _Why are we not pro-job creation, pro-legal immigration, and so many other issues we could – and should – champion?_

For the past eight years, it doesn’t feel like we are for anything, we're just against everything!

I'll have much more to say about this as the year goes on, but the reality is that nobody is going to solve our problems for us. It's going to take each of us to chart a more hopeful path forward for our country. I’m not saying that any of this will be easy, but we're not afraid of the challenge, are we?
---

clean_body: I’m often asked why I think so many Republican leaders who had been outspoken critics of former President Trump over the past eight years seem to suddenly do a U-turn and endorse his candidacy.| | | Peter, It’s a question I’ve thought about quite a bit this year. I’m often asked why I think so many Republican leaders who had been outspoken critics of former President Trump over the past eight years seem to suddenly do a U-turn and endorse his candidacy. "Gov. John Kasich on MSNBC 3-8-24" | | | ---|---|--- As you know, after being a first-hand witness to his endless barrage of shocking words and divisive behavior when I opposed him in the 2016 presidential campaign, I was resolved never to support a candidate like him. I may have paid a heavy price politically for that decision, but it's not one that I've ever regretted because it simply came down to what I thought was best for America. And, in the long run, what was best for conservative Republican values. You know my track record. I've been in the trenches fighting for those values for more than forty years and I cherish them deeply. As a well-known “budget hawk” during my 18 years in Congress, I chaired the U.S. House Budget Committee and spent much of my time working to achieve the first balanced federal budget in decades. (And the last balanced budget anyone’s been able to achieve ever since!) Supporting pro-growth policies and fiscal restraint used to be critical components of what it meant to be a Republican. As governor of Ohio, I continued to champion conservative principles such as fiscal restraint, removing burdensome regulations that were standing in the way of job creation, and cutting taxes to help create a better business climate. It was a winning formula as we created approximately 500,000 new private-sector jobs, while not leaving anyone behind. It seems that for many in politics today, while they call themselves Republicans, their policies are not consistent with the conservative values of traditional Republicans. Why have we become the party that enables a toxic and divisive figure like Trump or his enablers in Congress? Why do we not have any kind of hopeful vision for the future of America? Why are we retreating from our international alliances? Why are we not pro-job creation, pro-legal immigration, and so many other issues we could – and should – champion? For the past eight years, it doesn’t feel like we are for anything, we're just against everything! I'll have much more to say about this as the year goes on, but the reality is that nobody is going to solve our problems for us. It's going to take each of us to chart a more hopeful path forward for our country. I’m not saying that any of this will be easy, but we're not afraid of the challenge, are we? I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can. . Will you please consider chipping in right now to help with this important cause and ensure that we can keep up the fight for a better America? I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Thank you! -John | | | Get the Latest Updates: | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Kasich for America, not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.JohnKasich.com

name: Gallego for Arizona
subject: Good news and bad news
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada Rosen for Nevada
body:
If you haven’t seen the news yet, Kyrsten Sinema isn’t running for reelection.
| | |
---
Team:

If you haven’t seen the news yet, Kyrsten Sinema isn’t running for reelection in Arizona. Arizona’s Senate campaign is going to be a head-to-head between Ruben Gallego and Kari Lake.
And we’ve got some good news, and some bad news.

**The good news** is that we’ve built an incredible campaign so far. We’ve got close to 150,000 individual donors, and we’ve raised enough to be really competitive this year.

**The bad news** is that this campaign is about to get a lot more complicated – and expensive. We’re expecting millions of dollars in attack ads to start coming our way any day now. More than $230 million was spent in Arizona’s Senate campaign in 2022, and we expect this one to be just as expensive.
**What that means is that we need a huge surge of donations from folks who have been on the sidelines so far to stay competitive. We need you to make a donation today.**
Our average contribution is about $24. Some give more, many give less. Today, the most important thing is that you make that donation.

clean_body: Here’s the truth: | | | Peter -- In just a moment, we are going to ask you to make your first online contribution to President Biden's reelection campaign. Please give us a chance to explain why this request -- especially today -- is so important. Here is the truth: In just over two weeks, we close the books on the first quarterly FEC deadline of the year. After this deadline, we're legally required to report how much money we've raised so far in 2024. Everyone will be watching. The press, the Trump campaign, and critical outside spending organizations ready with potential attack ads against the President. With Trump now the presumptive Republican nominee, it is more important than ever that we send a message about the strength of our grassroots campaign -- the kind of message that can alter the media coverage of this race and give us some more momentum. But more important than that, reaching our goals is what we need to do in order to win. The amount we raise in this quarter will determine the scope of investments our campaign will be able to make as we get closer to Election Day. We already have ads running and our opponents do as well. So we need to consistently hit our numbers or we risk falling behind. And in a race as close as ours, that would be disastrous. We don't need you to give to every email we send, but a well-timed donation from 236 Cresco supporters before this FEC deadline comes to a close would mean a lot. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thank you in advance for chipping in. body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240315_symposium&n=1)
---
Friend, Historian Chris Fogarty's book "Ireland 1845-1850: The Perfect Genocide" demonstrates how "There was no famine in the ordinary sense of that word [during the "Irish Potato Famine."] It was genocide perpetrated by more than half of Britain's army (67 regiments of its 130 regiments total). They removed, at gunpoint, Ireland's abundant meats, livestock, and food crops to the ports for export; thus starving the people." Today the deliberate starvation of the people of Gaza confronts us all. Though much of this criminal behavior is perpetrated under the banner of the United States of America, the methods of depopulation and perpetual war for geopolitical purposes infamously belong to the British Empire and British colonialism, from Ireland to India to Gaza. As we approach the 250th Anniversary of the American Revolution we should recall that our Revolution was designed to end such horrific practices. Henry Carey, the son of Irish revolutionary Matthew Carey, and a close collaborator of Abraham Lincoln, summarized that:
> "There are two systems are before the world: One looks to pauperism, ignorance, depopulation, and barbarism; the other in increasing wealth, comfort, intelligence, combination of action, and civilization. One looks towards universal war; the other towards universal peace. One is the English system; the other we may be proud to call the American system, for it is the only one ever devised the tendency of which was that of elevating while equalizing the condition of man throughout the world."

**Gov. Walz shares his family's IVF journey as Democrats look to guarantee access to treatments**
\- Star Tribune
Peter,
Last month, the Alabama Supreme Court ruled that frozen embryos created during fertility treatments should be considered children under the law, setting a dangerous precedent for IVF access across the country.
My wife and I went through fertility treatments for seven years. It's no coincidence that we named our daughter Hope. Reproductive care like IVF is personal – to our family and so many others. We’re going to make sure it stays protected in Minnesota.
When Donald Trump’s 6-3 Supreme Court Majority overturned Roe v. Wade, we knew it was just the beginning. That’s why I signed the PRO Act into law last year, making Minnesota the first state to codify reproductive freedom into law since the Dobbs decision.
While the PRO Act protects access to fertility treatments like IVF, the ruling in Alabama proves we cannot take anything for granted.
Make no mistake: As long as I’m governor, Minnesota will continue to be a beacon of reproductive freedom. But absolutely none of our work is possible without you and the support you give us, year in and year out.
With our next mid-month fundraising deadline of this critical election year coming up tomorrow at midnight, it’s essential we reach our budget target so we can keep up our critical work and keep the GOP from dragging us backward.
[**Peter, if you’re able, will you make a donation of $10, $25, $50, or whatever works for you to defend reproductive freedom up and down the ballot this November and beyond?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80958341/460934606/-704849094?refcode=body&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTZlZmIyYS0yOWUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lfv36WW4mKM7quF7qDjGAgz2G2myRN63Vua-3khBXIk=)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80959497/460937440/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjg3YWRhN2MtMmFlMi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iFyYZil1Zqarc6kN9ZuXWWan63vxCHIrhDpDlFKUvPg=&emci=3b21c475-2ae2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&emdi=f87ada7c-2ae2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Have you seen one of these billboards lately?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80959500/460937441/-593472309?refcode=20240308-EM-EpochTimesBillboards2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjg3YWRhN2MtMmFlMi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iFyYZil1Zqarc6kN9ZuXWWan63vxCHIrhDpDlFKUvPg=)
_Photo Credit: PBS_
You're not alone if you’re wondering what’s up with these billboards. Millions and millions of American have seen these bizarre advertisements for the “#1 Trusted News” source _The Epoch Times_ in big cities and large interstates across the country.
[**We’ll tell you more about _The Epoch Times_ below (and why their billboard campaign should alarm you), but if you’re ready to make a difference in COURIER’s fight against right-wing misinformation, can you chip in $10 to support our honest journalism? **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80959505/460937442/-593472309?refcode=20240308-EM-EpochTimesBillboards2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjg3YWRhN2MtMmFlMi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iFyYZil1Zqarc6kN9ZuXWWan63vxCHIrhDpDlFKUvPg=)
**Far from America’s “#1 Trusted News” source,_The Epoch Times_ is a right-wing propaganda outlet that’s publishing dangerous misinformation on everything from January 6th to COVID vaccines. **
You wouldn’t get that from their billboards or marketing. They brand themselves as a “truly independent” news organization. They’ve run ads under the banner of “Pure American Journalism” or “Honest Paper.”
**The truth is far darker.**
During the 2020 election, _The Epoch Times_ spent millions in advertising for Donald Trump. **In fact, the outlet spent more money on social media advertising for Trump than any other organization outside of the Trump campaign.**
That’s not all. _The Epoch Times_ has made millions propping COVID-19 misinformation, the Big Lie, and other baseless conspiracy theories. **All the while, they’ve been masquerading as trustworthy independent journalism. **
**We see right through them, but what about those who exclusively get their news from social media? What about the thousands served daily with a barrage of ads saying _The Epoch Times_ is trustworthy, real news?**
We founded COURIER as the good information antidote to the bad information that outlets like The Epoch Times push. We deliver _factual_ stories to the online spaces where people actually spend their time. We fight misinformation from _The Epoch Times_ and other right-wing bad actors at its source.
[**If we’re going to keep exposing right-wing propaganda outlets like _The Epoch Times_ , we need resources to keep our newsrooms running. You wouldn’t get that from their billboards or marketing. They brand themselves as a “truly independent” news organization. They’ve run ads under the banner of “Pure American Journalism” or “Honest Paper.” The truth is far darker. During the 2020 election, The Epoch Times spent millions in advertising for Donald Trump. In fact, the outlet spent more money on social media advertising for Trump than any other organization outside of the Trump campaign. That’s not all. The Epoch Times has made millions propping COVID-19 misinformation, the Big Lie, and other baseless conspiracy theories. Medicaid expansion has been touted as a solution to the problem of uninsured Americans, but the reality is that it's a flawed policy with significant negative consequences. Let's explore the reasons why Medicaid expansion is bad and why it's not the solution we need to address the issue of healthcare access.
**Increased Medicaid costs:**
One of the primary concerns with Medicaid expansion is the increased cost to taxpayers. Medicaid is a joint federal-state program, and when states expand Medicaid, they must contribute a portion of the cost. This means that state budgets are stretched even thinner, and taxpayers are left footing the bill.
**Reduced access to care for low-income individuals:**
Medicaid expansion has led to a surge in spending but reduced healthcare access for traditional Medicaid enrollees, such as low-income children and people with disabilities. In expansion states, hospital Medicaid shortfalls have increased by 117% since 2013, while profits have plummeted by two-thirds. This means that hospitals are at a higher risk of closure, which can significantly reduce access to care for low-income individuals.
**No improvement in health outcomes:**
Despite the increased spending on Medicaid, there is no evidence that Medicaid expansion improves health outcomes. A study published in the New England Journal of Medicine found that Medicaid expansion had no significant effect on mortality rates or other measures of health status. This suggests that the money spent on Medicaid expansion could be better used to fund other healthcare initiatives that have a more significant impact on health outcomes.
**Increased reliance on government programs:**
Medicaid expansion encourages individuals to become reliant on government programs for their healthcare needs. This can lead to a cycle of dependency, where individuals are less motivated to seek employment or pursue educational opportunities that could help them achieve financial independence. Instead of expanding Medicaid, we should focus on creating policies that promote economic growth and job creation, which would provide more people with the means to obtain private health insurance.
**Crowding out private insurance:**
Medicaid expansion can also lead to a phenomenon known as "crowd out," where individuals who would otherwise have private health insurance instead enroll in Medicaid. This can result in higher costs for taxpayers, as well as reduced access to care for those who remain on private insurance.
Medicaid expansion is not the solution to the problem of uninsured Americans. It leads to increased costs, reduced access to care, no improvement in health outcomes, increased reliance on government programs, and crowding out of private insurance.
Instead of expanding Medicaid, we should focus on creating policies that promote economic growth, job creation, and private health insurance options. By doing so, we can ensure that all Americans have access to quality healthcare without sacrificing fiscal responsibility or individual freedom.

name: =?utf-8?Q?Michael=20Greenberg?=
subject: Watch Us Shut Down Chevron's CEO
body:
| | | | |
---
Meet Mike Wirth. Mike is the CEO of Chevron, a company responsible for dumping untold amounts of oil waste in Indigenous lands in [Ecuador](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=4ad7c6eeb1&e=c0a1c11fc3), causing mass suffering, and then refusing to pay the billions of dollars they owe to Ecuadorians.
[](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=71cc0767ed&e=c0a1c11fc3)
This week, this climate criminal was a guest of honor at a hoity toity “corporate diversity event” in Manhattan. Mike probably thought this was going to be an easy afternoon of shooting the breeze and burnishing his own image. He thought it would go well for him.
Reader, [it did not go well for him](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=100e57c2d0&e=c0a1c11fc3)!
Just as Mike was regaling the crowd with tales of how much of a champion for diversity he is, our group of brave activists stormed the stage and shut him down. You can watch the entire thing unfold here: [watch](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=12cc0d8f2f&e=c0a1c11fc3).
[](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=567454c194&e=c0a1c11fc3)
As activists listed Mister Mike’s many misdeeds, he sat idly with a vacant smirk on his face before fleeing the stage. Security pushed and shoved and carried our team out, but they cannot dull our spirit or resolve.
We are Climate Defiance. We don’t circulate letters that go nowhere. We don’t politely ask politicians for meetings. We don’t just raise money for the sake of raising money.
**We do direct action. We get in the face of climate criminals like Mike Wirth, call them out for their misdeeds, and share videos of them fleeing in disgrace.**
And we get results.
We’ve disrupted [Joe Manchin](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=087677ee97&e=c0a1c11fc3) so many times that he realized a coal baron running for President was probably not going to have a great time.
We HOUNDED ConocoPhillips Director Jody Freeman, forcing her off the stage at the American Constitution Society and shutting down the Harvard Climate Forum to protest her. Due to this, as well as the good work from partner groups, she resigned almost immediately after our actions.
We majorly disrupted Senior Advisor to the President John Podesta right after the White House approved Willow. We shut down an entire fundraiser because he was speaking there. Afterwards, he brought US in for a meeting. And shortly after that, the White House announced a pause in the construction of new LNG Terminals, a major victory the climate movement, and even [cited us](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=083b0163da&e=c0a1c11fc3) in their briefing.
If you're tired of sitting by and listening to empty promises from politicians, we urge you to join us in this movement and take action. **You can sign up for our group by clicking the button below.**
Together we can win.
Michael
| [Join The Climate Defiance Movement](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=9eb147233e&e=c0a1c11fc3)

subject: We’re trying something new

body:
[1]Powered By People

Powered by People volunteers are registering voters at farmers markets,
college campuses, even at their front doors — anywhere they can find
eligible, unregistered Democrats.

That’s how we registered Chloe, who told us she’ll be casting a ballot for
the very first time this year.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240314.BaIMwM&refcode=ema20240314-239517&t=1001&akid=239517%2E444211%2EcQ7vrc ][IMG]

In addition to registering voters like Chloe, we’re also finding ways to
stay in touch with them throughout the election year. This personal
relationship between the volunteer and the new voter allows us to help
them navigate Texas’ tough voting laws and ensure that they are much more
likely to cast a ballot in November.

Why are we doing this?

There were 2.7 million registered, likely Democrats who didn’t vote in
2020. Imagine if they’d had personal connections with volunteers who
checked in on them to ask if they had any questions about the election, to
remind them about the importance of voting, and to help them find their
polling place.

I think we’re past the point where impersonal broadcast text messages
(“Dear Voter, make sure you vote today!”) are effective. Personal,
human-to-human contact with newly registered voters is the kind of

Here it goes.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80963713/460948864/1328794144?refcode=ea.d45409c0-2fe2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&ms=ea.d45409c0-2fe2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ0NTQwOWMwLTJmZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-aBQoGVPq1KW_AP4AkXtznm1vpA1j5kxJzS8UIrvNC8=&emci=1d8c9351-10e2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&emdi=d45409c0-2fe2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&ceid=4823105)

We have good news and bad news to share with you. **Let’s start with the hard truth:** Our climate is rapidly changing. February 2024 was the 9th consecutive month to break its own heat record, and March could very well be the 10th. While skyrocketing temperatures alone pose a direct threat to the health and well-being of millions of people worldwide, the consequences go far beyond unseasonably warm months. Droughts, floods, fires and other severe weather events are wreaking havoc on communities and are accelerating, and outpacing, our ability to adapt. Vital ecosystems are on the brink of collapse across the globe, and historically marginalized communities are disproportionately affected by this crisis. All the while the main perpetrators of the climate crisis are consistently avoiding accountability because of their outsized influence on our political system. **Now, for the encouraging part:** We still have time to turn things around. The science is clear — if we start to phase down our dependence on fossil fuels and commit to a just transition to clean energy now, we _can_ slow the acceleration of the climate crisis and give our planet the opportunity to heal from the damage done by extracting and burning fossil fuels. It won’t happen overnight, but it will happen if we act before it’s too late. The even better news is that we have a real pathway to force this action — there are hundreds of leaders running for office in communities across the country who are putting it all on the line to fight for the changes we need at every level of government. As the general election draws closer and closer, our team is committed to building on our successes so far and supporting as many climate champions as we can. But we can’t do it alone. clean_body: Here it goes. | We have good news and bad news to share with you. Let’s start with the hard truth: Our climate is rapidly changing. February 2024 was the 9th consecutive month to break its own heat record, and March could very well be the 10th. While skyrocketing temperatures alone pose a direct threat to the health and well-being of millions of people worldwide, the consequences go far beyond unseasonably warm months. Droughts, floods, fires and other severe weather events are wreaking havoc on communities and are accelerating, and outpacing, our ability to adapt. Vital ecosystems are on the brink of collapse across the globe, and historically marginalized communities are disproportionately affected by this crisis. All the while the main perpetrators of the climate crisis are consistently avoiding accountability because of their outsized influence on our political system. Now, for the encouraging part: We still have time to turn things around. The science is clear — if we start to phase down our dependence on fossil fuels and commit to a just transition to clean energy now, we can slow the acceleration of the climate crisis and give our planet the opportunity to heal from the damage done by extracting and burning fossil fuels. It won’t happen overnight, but it will happen if we act before it’s too late. The even better news is that we have a real pathway to force this action — there are hundreds of leaders running for office in communities across the country who are putting it all on the line to fight for the changes we need at every level of government. As the general election draws closer and closer, our team is committed to building on our successes so far and supporting as many climate champions as we can. But we can’t do it alone. Look, while we're up against significant challenges this year, it's crucial to remember our strength lies in unity and action. We've set a $150,000 goal this month, but we're barely halfway there, even as we're approaching mid-March. This goal is make-or-break, and I’m counting on you. In Service, Col. | | Friend,I knew this was coming. A sinister bill is making its way through the Illinois legislature......and if it passes, it’s only a matter of time before other states – blue, purple, and red alike – adopt this policy.**Illinois House Bill 4876 would change the definition of “abused child” to include minors whose parents object to their children receiving puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, transgender surgeries, and abortions.** _It also conveniently shields doctors from liability if they prescribe these treatments to minors without parental consent._ I know how this ends._Doctors coerced Layla Jane into a double mastectomy at 13 years old.__Doctors coerced Chloe Cole into a double mastectomy at 15 years old.__Doctors coerced Luka Hein into a double mastectomy at 16 years old._ And all three regret the “gender affirming care” inflicted upon them.**Now the state of Illinois wants to put thousands of kids in their position – but without the opportunity to later file a medical negligence lawsuit against predatory doctors.** This is SICK.And worst of all, this bill gives the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) the power to remove children from their homes based on their new definition of an “abused child.”If this bill passes in Illinois, it’s only a matter of time before rabid leftists push for this in your state. That’s why our work has never been more important than it is right now, and why we’re counting on patriots like you.My name is Harmeet Dhillon, and I founded the Center for American Liberty to fight for our freedoms, fight for our families, and fight for our futures. Our not-for-profit law firm is leading the charge defending parental rights and pioneering landmark litigation holding gender clinics accountable for performing “gender affirming care” on minors, because we know we can’t afford to lose this battle.And we don’t charge the parents or de-transitioners we represent a DIME for our services. It’s only with the support of patriots like you that we’re able to pursue justice for our clients.**[So if you’re in the position to make a generous, tax-deductible donation today to fight for parental rights, please don’t hesitate.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/1fE1XqD4uKuYvIqui0gkVw~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1eC0P0SZaHR0cHM6Ly9hbmVkb3QubGliZXJ0eWNlbnRlci5vcmcvMWYzMDVjNTItYTQwMi00ZWQ5LTg1MDUtNGVlODA0YTViMTc0P3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QkRHLVJFTiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVNJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDMxNF9CREdfQ0ZBTF9JTExJTk9JU19SRU5fUEEtQUZSVwNzcGNCCmXvA0bzZUNsIAFSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The Left is willing to destroy our children, destroy our families and ultimately destroy our country if it means they get what they want.To them, the ends will always justify the means.We can’t change their minds by just showing them studies or sharing heartbreaking testimonies from heroes like Chloe Cole, Layla Jane, Luka Hein, Aurora Regino or Jessica Konen._The only way they’ll stop is if we beat them in court and make it so expensive to participate in this madness that doctors, teachers, and politicians become afraid to even think of transitioning children._ Illinois law already classifies child abuse as a criminal offense ranging from a misdemeanor that carries a maximum sentence of one year in prison and a $2,500 fine to a felony that can carry up to $25,000 in fines and 15 years behind bars.No concerned parent should risk prison time for doing right by their own children.If you agree, I hope the Center for American Liberty can count on your support.

A sinister bill is making its way through the Illinois legislature......and if it passes, it’s only a matter of time before other states – blue, purple, and red alike – adopt this policy.Illinois House Bill 4876 would change the definition of “abused child” to include minors whose parents object to their children receiving puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, transgender surgeries, and abortions. It also conveniently shields doctors from liability if they prescribe these treatments to minors without parental consent. I know how this ends.Doctors coerced Layla Jane into a double mastectomy at 13 years old.Doctors coerced Chloe Cole into a double mastectomy at 15 years old.Doctors coerced Luka Hein into a double mastectomy at 16 years old. And all three regret the “gender affirming care” inflicted upon them.Now the state of Illinois wants to put thousands of kids in their position – but without the opportunity to later file a medical negligence lawsuit against predatory doctors. This is SICK.And worst of all, this bill gives the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) the power to remove children from their homes based on their new definition of an “abused child.”If this bill passes in Illinois, it’s only a matter of time before rabid leftists push for this in your state. That’s why our work has never been more important than it is right now, and why we’re counting on patriots like you.My name is Harmeet Dhillon, and I founded the Center for American Liberty to fight for our freedoms, fight for our families, and fight for our futures. Our not-for-profit law firm is leading the charge defending parental rights and pioneering landmark litigation holding gender clinics accountable for performing “gender affirming care” on minors, because we know we can’t afford to lose this battle.And we don’t charge the parents or de-transitioners we represent a DIME for our services. It’s only with the support of patriots like you that we’re able to pursue justice for our clients. The Left is willing to destroy our children, destroy our families and ultimately destroy our country if it means they get what they want.To them, the ends will always justify the means.We can’t change their minds by just showing them studies or sharing heartbreaking testimonies from heroes like Chloe Cole, Layla Jane, Luka Hein, Aurora Regino or Jessica Konen.The only way they’ll stop is if we beat them in court and make it so expensive to participate in this madness that doctors, teachers, and politicians become afraid to even think of transitioning children. Illinois law already classifies child abuse as a criminal offense ranging from a misdemeanor that carries a maximum sentence of one year in prison and a $2,500 fine to a felony that can carry up to $25,000 in fines and 15 years behind bars.No concerned parent should risk prison time for doing right by their own children.If you agree, I hope the Center for American Liberty can count on your support. | | | | | | | Sincerely, Harmeet K. Families are trying to keep older adults safe during deadly heat waves. Households are rationing power during extreme weather. Streets and neighborhoods are inaccessible during chronic flooding. We see the writing on the wall, and it's clear that climate change is already here. We can't sit back and allow things to keep going the way they are. We can't afford to! But big change starts with small movements. So, we need your help to keep our momentum going. Small movements start with putting the right leaders in office. That means electing candidates who are ready to take on the fight against climate change today. But we don't want to stop there. We need investment and support in research that helps our communities mitigate the worst effects. We need to better understand how to handle the effects of a changing climate, the long-term impacts on our communities, and how to alleviate these ongoing risks. body:
I know that if we’re going to win, I have to make sure that all of Arizona knows my story and what I stand for.
#

Peter, these campaigns are full of decisions.
I don’t have to tell you that we’re up against Kari Lake right now. She ran a full statewide campaign in 2022, she’s got the endorsement of Trump, millions of MAGA followers nationwide. You name it — everybody knows her.
Me, I’m a Congressman... a big job in my community, but I’ve never run for a statewide office. I don’t have billionaires or former presidents lining up to support me. And when I think about it I’m still just a dad, a husband, a Marine.
I know that if we’re going to win, I have to make sure that all of Arizona knows my story and what I stand for.
[**That’s why we decided to put up our first TV ad of the cycle, Lucky Lima. You can watch it here.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruben-em-ad24?noskip=true&refcode=em240314-1-160&refcode2=2072_734936_o2P45p&akid=2072%2E734936%2Eo2P45p)

Here’s the thing, though... once you go up on TV, you can’t come back down. We have to keep this up if our strategy is going to work. And we’ve still got about eight months until Election Day.
That’s why going up this early was such a tough decision. But we decided to do it because this team has always had my back, and it’s why I’m writing to you now.
We’ve got millions of dollars to raise to pay for these ads. To win this race. To hold the Senate, and to help defeat Trump in Arizona.
I know a donation of $20 seems like a drop in the bucket compared to what we need to raise, but I also know that if everybody reading this right now chipped in we’d absolutely destroy our fundraising goals.
Not everybody donates, though. And that’s why I’m counting on you.
