body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, There's been a big shakeup in Colorado politics this week with [Ken Buck's early exit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from Congress. All the info you need on the updated CD4 race and special election are below. This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 14, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Lauren Boebert won’t pursue special election nomination to replace Ken Buck after his abrupt resignation**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert will not seek the Republican [special election nomination](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to replace U.S. Rep. Ken Buck in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District after his departure on March 22.

* Boebert remains in the Republican primary race for the GOP nominee for the November election in the 4th District, expressing concerns about the confusion and representation gaps that may arise from an immediate special election.

* [Buck's early resignation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) caught many by surprise and impacts the already contentious GOP primary race in the 4th District, which includes Douglas County and Loveland, creating uncertainty and scrambling the political landscape.

* Gov. Jared Polis plans to schedule the special election for June 25, coinciding with Colorado’s primary, potentially giving the Republican vacancy nominee an advantage due to double ballot appearance, although this could lead to voter confusion. Both Republican and Democratic vacancy committees will need to select their respective nominees for the special election.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**COMMENTARY: Colorado’s Circular Firing Squad on the 2nd Amendment**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY THE COLORADO FREEDOM FORCE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Whether the decided-upon strategy of the anti-2nd Amendment legislators in Colorado is “Throw everything up against the wall and see what sticks”, or just “divide and conquer”, their numerous attempts at whittling away at the 2nd Amendment can be hard to keep up with.

* From a straightforward “assault weapons” ban to imposing more fees or adding an 11% excise tax to guns and ammunition, Colorado’s Democrats have formed a circular firing squad around this fundamental right.

* You can [learn about all seven active bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), use online forms to contact your representatives or read the entirety of a bill through the [Colorado Freedom Force website](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Saying no to veto, Gov. Jared Polis signs bill exempting lawmakers from open meetings law**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Gov. Jared Polis swiftly signed [Senate Bill 24-157](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) into law, exempting lawmakers from Colorado's open meetings law, citing the need for clarity on legislative procedures and respecting the separation of powers.

* [Effective immediately](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), the law defines "public business," enabling discussions on bills and public policy via email or text message, exempt from open meetings law but subject to open records requests.

* Critics, including First Amendment attorney Steve Zansberg, express disappointment, especially during "National Sunshine Week," arguing the law undermines transparency by allowing secret discussions on public matters. The General Assembly faced lawsuits over open meetings law violations, including secret voting and clandestine caucus meetings, leading to settlement agreements to cease such practices.

* Supporters, like Speaker pro-Tem Chris deGruy Kennedy, defend the bill, asserting it doesn't obstruct transparency but rather addresses challenges in legislative communications, although opposition from transparency advocates persists.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Libertarians will gather for party’s convention March 23-24 in Colorado Springs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | MARCH 13** _The Colorado Libertarian Party’s Convention is Saturday-Sunday, March 23-24 in Colorado Springs at the Masonic Center, 1150 Panorama Dr._ **[Family Dollar had net sales loss of -1.2% in 4th quarter, leading to 970 stores set for closure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | NATIONAL | MARCH 13** _Dollar Tree, Inc., [DLTR] dropped 15% in early trading Wednesday following news it would close nearly 1,000 stores, mostly within the lowest-performing Family Dollar franchise._ [**21st Judicial District slates open house for Juvenile Diversion, Lighthouse programs**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | RMV STAFF | MARCH 13** _An open house has been announced for 2-6 p.m. Wednesday, March 20, during which time the public will be invited by the 21st Judicial District Attorney’s Office to tour new space of the Juvenile Diversion and Lighthouse Program at Colorado Mesa University, 1060 Orchard Ave._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. ## **IV3 is Going Open Source**
---
We have an exciting update to share about [IV3](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.sV4MFbzBllccGzy2svLCokN9gYO8jdh-gSJJK-hMZ8MuwQarFK8uveiTwuNNpIl1BO0hLCdJFOwl4U61NkEK7JakHP5I8pOzXqkPA7Qry7VnmKJf_tOZk2Wd5EbzjUwDmTHNrE3-6rWxTp1aVd4eXyp4y5iS7A0lzj0ziac5sM2Ac7OxEXM1YFkr012V9tZUZdK0IU5641XlnPFC5DD-QQ/44n/U2a5bPwcT8Sb9Z9xggRT6Q/h2/h001.FpHLUq4VrxbQAOPYCddWz3-fE6XZ4FLw-Vr3TuJpd10)!
First, a quick history ... In 2021, we launched IV3 as a web-based application available for volunteers who were interested in verifying the accuracy of their local voter rolls by identifying ineligible records and reporting findings to local election authorities. In 2022, over 40,000 volunteers participated in the IV3 project, and hundreds of thousands of records were submitted through their efforts.
In 2023, we put the program on pause. We wanted to add features and enhance usability, but our biggest goal was to expand the reach of the toolset. So many new election integrity groups were starting up and looking for apps they could use independently, we knew we could help them move faster up the learning curve. So, we decided to open source everything.
Effective today, we are posting tranches of our code onto [Open.Ink](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.wq-e3y6f99vGqkmmgoJyK8Z5HkkJvVGC_l8JumQuUQNeeIPgjRM0BnS45u8rcOdg8UAuNvwZYgBbWCBcK_NKsek_BvKiG1iLTrmHV7y_Dbu4bgSlFSECPgzPe008DsRtEm5XTnVSSBbXfPUEPYUmcgoRS4F0kY39QZDanjiiKr7f6qh7enh6kC7y-p8MWy0PGVsQbsvt5VaBGW5dpB5pdg/44n/U2a5bPwcT8Sb9Z9xggRT6Q/h3/h001.uIV82-q5d7MxXkMD6KYr8bv-Db2slySliK2QpjthfY8) via GitHub, starting with with our normalization program and continuing on until the entire app code base has been posted.
| | [Attn Developers: You can find the code and tech specs here. ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.flIQTCCIxNEqWg_ApxSzThzI9Cvjb-6YMkdp1BmH_2SaY4XK5XLOQvktRgiztlt6ShB94spmXK6VhCtorLkTJvst2MKbQF7f-xx64TzYG0JZZga4x5Ch5aXcyrMhNwHdEdLDzc523x5mEPkignk88rmkiDOD-M3yq9ExIAHAA1IUScHdIahrXWOn1-cP5r3hT2pLy3Wqfkd3TMz0cmypd3huvd1p2gRdxubiXn-Rezv2KVU2nR1CHgMLf4idD702hUVXfMvY6qON8BaFNr2tbQ/44n/U2a5bPwcT8Sb9Z9xggRT6Q/h4/h001.NqI35g_1aF9sT7YhxSADg1Z4Zg_8Bq0ws6Ew6mDg590)
---
What is normalization? For our purposes, normalization is the process of standardizing differently formatted state voter roll datasets. This allows for easier identification of patterns, trends, and relationships, all of which help support more accurate interpretations of the data. **Over 700 programming hours went into developing this piece of the program, so for groups that are just starting out, this is a huge leap forward.**
**Crucially, we 're offering everything completely free of charge.** While we encourage users to contribute to the improvement of the codebase by reporting any bugs or enhancement recommendations, there are no barriers to access. Our hope is that this initiative will spark the development of numerous new applications, each contributing to the shared goal of cleaning up voter rolls across the country.
The urgency of this endeavor cannot be overstated. Our recent evaluations have revealed that over 25 million voter records in the United States could be ineligible - more than enough to compromise the integrity of the 2024 election, and the future of our nation. Addressing this issue is paramount to ensuring fair and transparent electoral processes. By decentralizing access to the tools necessary for verification, the pro-liberty community can take a significant step towards achieving this goal.
We invite all tech enthusiasts to explore the documentation and source code we are making available. Whether you're a seasoned developer or just beginning your journey, we believe you'll find value in what IV3 has to offer. Eligibility programs and the user interface are set to be released in the coming days and all the components will be at your disposal to launch your own version of IV3.
We remain committed to our mission of empowering citizens and are incredibly excited about the possibilities this initiative presents. Working together, we really can true the vote!

## **Hand Count the Ballots, Josh!**
We second President of PA Patriot Coalition and former CIA Operations Officer Sam Faddis’ message to Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro. When only 20% of Americans trust the outcome of our elections, the Governor’s “Election Integrity” task force needs a new focus: hand count the ballots, Josh. Anything else is just another divisive political game.

clean_body: Commit today to work in your local elections in 2024. | | | March 14, 2024 | | | IV3 is Going Open Source We have an exciting update to share about ! First, a quick history ... In 2021, we launched IV3 as a web-based application available for volunteers who were interested in verifying the accuracy of their local voter rolls by identifying ineligible records and reporting findings to local election authorities. In 2022, over 40,000 volunteers participated in the IV3 project, and hundreds of thousands of records were submitted through their efforts. In 2023, we put the program on pause. We wanted to add features and enhance usability, but our biggest goal was to expand the reach of the toolset. So many new election integrity groups were starting up and looking for apps they could use independently, we knew we could help them move faster up the learning curve. So, we decided to open source everything. Effective today, we are posting tranches of our code onto via GitHub, starting with with our normalization program and continuing on until the entire app code base has been posted. | | What is normalization? For our purposes, normalization is the process of standardizing differently formatted state voter roll datasets. This allows for easier identification of patterns, trends, and relationships, all of which help support more accurate interpretations of the data. Over 700 programming hours went into developing this piece of the program, so for groups that are just starting out, this is a huge leap forward. Crucially, we 're offering everything completely free of charge. While we encourage users to contribute to the improvement of the codebase by reporting any bugs or enhancement recommendations, there are no barriers to access. Our hope is that this initiative will spark the development of numerous new applications, each contributing to the shared goal of cleaning up voter rolls across the country. The urgency of this endeavor cannot be overstated. Our recent evaluations have revealed that over 25 million voter records in the United States could be ineligible - more than enough to compromise the integrity of the 2024 election, and the future of our nation. Addressing this issue is paramount to ensuring fair and transparent electoral processes. By decentralizing access to the tools necessary for verification, the pro-liberty community can take a significant step towards achieving this goal. We invite all tech enthusiasts to explore the documentation and source code we are making available. Whether you're a seasoned developer or just beginning your journey, we believe you'll find value in what IV3 has to offer. Eligibility programs and the user interface are set to be released in the coming days and all the components will be at your disposal to launch your own version of IV3. We remain committed to our mission of empowering citizens and are incredibly excited about the possibilities this initiative presents. Working together, we really can true the vote! | Hand Count the Ballots, Josh! We second President of PA Patriot Coalition and former CIA Operations Officer Sam Faddis’ message to Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro. When only 20% of Americans trust the outcome of our elections, the Governor’s “Election Integrity” task force needs a new focus: hand count the ballots, Josh. Anything else is just another divisive political game. | | About Tonight’s Webinar Our Grassroots Webinar with True the Vote’s Catherine Engelbrecht filled up in record time! But we will be announcing another session soon! Stay tuned! | | Want to make a difference right now? Tell a friend about! | Until Next Week ... Ever Onward - Your TTV Team P.S. subject: I have an opponent

body:
It’s official, team: John Deaton, a well-funded Republican, has launched a campaign to run against me for Senate in Massachusetts.
Apparently, the MAGA Republican machine couldn’t find a single Republican in Massachusetts to run against me — so they brought in someone from Rhode Island who will have the backing of the GOP and special interest groups.
This much is clear: We’re up against national Republicans who are desperate to take back the Senate and pass Trump’s agenda. We’re up against their rich buddies who are trying to stop us from taxing the wealthy, regulating big banks, and making our government work for working people.
It’s going to take a strong grassroots movement to compete and win. Can you please split a donation of $20 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Seth Moulton? We need to respond to my opponent’s campaign launch with the strongest amount of grassroots donations to protect our Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-warren]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-warren]
I’m proud of the progress we’ve accomplished for Massachusetts families so far — like lowering the cost of hearing aids, passing a new tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, getting student loan debt canceled, securing billions in funding for projects like an electric bus fleet and infrastructure repairs, and so much more.
But there’s plenty more to do for working people in Massachusetts and across the country. We’ve got to bring down the cost of housing. Put child care within reach for all working parents. Protect our Commonwealth from the climate crisis. Take power away from powerful interests like Big Pharma, Big Oil, and big banks and put it in the hands of working people — which means we need to root corruption out of Washington. And I’ve got the most sweeping set of anti-corruption plans since Watergate.
This election is about who our government works for — and it’s about defending our democracy and our basic freedoms. I’m fighting to keep our Senate majority because if Republicans win any more power, they’ll restrict abortion access everywhere, even in blue states that have passed abortion protections — like Massachusetts. They’ll threaten voting rights, LGBTQIA+ rights, Social Security, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act — they’ll reward the rich and powerful, and embolden an extremist base across the country.
So I’m staying in this fight to stop MAGA extremism, continue standing up to powerful special interests, and make real change for working people. Are you with me?
Please respond to my opponent’s announcement today with a donation of $20 or anything you can to support this campaign and Seth Moulton. Grassroots supporters like you have helped defeat the GOP and special interests in the past, and I need your support again as we take on this new fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-warren]
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

| Peter, I'm running for Governor of Virginia, because this race is personal to me. Let me explain why.

Growing up, we moved around multiple times for my father’s job, but ultimately, we settled in Virginia. My parents — my father, a veteran and law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service. I attended Henrico County Public Schools and went on to attend the University of Virginia. After graduation, I began my career as a federal law enforcement officer — working on money laundering cases and tracking narcotics traffickers with the U.S. Postal Inspection Service. I then joined the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover, collecting intelligence, managing assets, and overseeing high-profile programs to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe.

And a successful business and family man.

I’m accountable to God, my family, and Montana voters—no one else.

Friend, Public service is my life. From serving in the military to being Governor of Maryland — I have made it my life’s mission to serve the people. That’s why I have to address the ongoing threat to our country’s democracy in the form of Donald Trump. This week, **Trump effectively secured the Republican nomination for the third presidential election in a row.** Here’s the bottom line: Americans have a very clear choice in this election. We can either support President Biden, who focuses on enhancing opportunities, pathways, and freedoms for the people around this country versus Donald Trump who will exclusively focus on his own freedom until November. The stakes couldn’t be clearer. We’re going to spend the next nine months hearing Trump fight for his freedom and his future. What we’re not going to hear is Trump fighting for _our_ freedoms or _our_ futures. If there is one thing that I have discovered from running a historic campaign to serving as Governor, it’s that **people drive democracy.** Participating in our democracy is vital to ensuring we all have a say in the future we all deserve. **Democracy is only as strong as its people.** We all have an important part to play in keeping our democracy functional and we must do what we can to protect voting rights and the right to cast a vote in a free and fair election. Democracy is on the line this year, friend. Thank you for supporting the effort to fight for our collective democratic values. Elevate, Wes Moore P.S. You can hear more about my thoughts on Trump as the GOP nominee by watching my appearance on Morning Joe. _**Attention, policymakers: Medicare Advantage enrollees love their coverage and their licensed agents**_ By Bobby Jindal and Steve Beshear
---
Even the most well-intentioned government actions risk backfiring when undertaken without due care and deliberation. Incremental, focused change helps ensure outcomes that align with the best interests of citizens. As former state governors, one a Democrat and one a Republican, we understand that principle, one we worked to make a hallmark of our administrations in Kentucky and Louisiana. Unfortunately, to judge by its aggressive and expanding intervention into the Medicare Advantage market, that’s a lesson the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services may have to learn the hard way. We applaud CMS officials, along with Sen. Ron Wyden (D-OR) and his colleagues in the Senate Finance Committee, for steps they have taken to protect Medicare beneficiaries from unscrupulous and unlicensed marketers peddling false promises and scare tactics. Bad actors should have no place in today’s Medicare Advantage market. ****[ ](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=41a52d902eab483a8551f54ff48edb86&_e=-69xulpvf2VTAyp1g0JuVwDQM7qcOQFFVS81srxnQymDYuiB3jcUtPHCvVwJQJp_vPy5nYUAHj0Ty0jdt0VxCiM5Cg3oR6nlBRGQLd3vUoHxiDlzDgpTAJO2JmT_lCjviq_3W9ng0I7LM7lP4XtpZ3lN2n5dYmtwmhS36EqL5gpXJ_AD51hrP3dqTD9W1fJF5Qgo1doAbH2J6IModj6Xg2BFM3lNv19KEaO4P97m4mxhfFH3f3CJai6RJx4V6-2oRrr6E6V2imBvdCXYHpDINGkbwuubUIqSsZAm9L5nKmWe5Qv4eilkKPYKRdB9cyNboqNuLcHh6JMs400iXP6pXyF5JpSnAvSJ6pfzHusYMXU%3D) [****FINISH********READING ON WASHINGTONEXAMINER.COM****](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=41a52d902eab483a8551f54ff48edb86&_e=-69xulpvf2VTAyp1g0JuVwDQM7qcOQFFVS81srxnQymDYuiB3jcUtPHCvVwJQJp_SyorGCzu3se7xqYGcTYgJOtyFq2AQT-CPDzF3yHtHai6fzMguhUKECIlym_cPYim5-x3QjNxYEef-LP9BBHZ2v8jG2XxWZaZwlMjfm1O3On4EmXb3RRWBNw2lKm5vy9P7aZ475EOVHFVc3OiMQT8IDxbuLDSSwnTUMS9QsXDfhl1dYBpGuMvdg5yNacmdxlNmL-Zv3UIqPcNoBjnpOg4ylQ-4Vw44DJHyuCNWpCsmGYsiKIYiPkrO69YUw-BADKpG0WiRxQTYTPnh9PRn8w86G7Yt5Nz0a_2nVMvoufrbfk%3D)****

Friend,

**********Wesley Hunt here.**

[**As we head into another election year, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I 'm running. **](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dbc44d008e9548ee833d5d76f1a0a229&_e=6qvHUDsk9mnxHfMwg15zyrhfqrN-oVh8FNAIwsxu6HHYjs2EG3uETcOj5p33-s63ThUo8yEP_7IwkBHmG-FlsOP02grBEXE4nwELSD_tzFycivDyS0fUcBJinsnex4kpGSA0sDYYq68O5eiD9s8eV5D7NfoNG_tvm7vp6Rb-KDgebkUUMRBZT7nvQKrirxGHwj10qqbCvc7uHFvamZhsuT9nAImbklfjgoUwEm5nPCdThjqbQUbhUVQjoDOrpPrl1pHl9Ppsb46FitCPJHIj469JpUYA5OG4h8-rufpI7Cw%3D)

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dbc44d008e9548ee833d5d76f1a0a229&_e=6qvHUDsk9mnxHfMwg15zyrhfqrN-oVh8FNAIwsxu6HHYjs2EG3uETcOj5p33-s63ThUo8yEP_7IwkBHmG-FlsOP02grBEXE4nwELSD_tzFycivDyS0fUcBJinsnex4kpGSA0sDYYq68O5eiD9s8eV_F1phhlAS1GRHE16vKhsUCbUyAjku4ZPx8HVjbcEKG1UHuN3LZRilZI335G8NF6ekNVtlNycGzu9K-PFZ65HCGgUO6nOJ7_Z5_WaOGwl7oVERS0RIV3AurTI0N7ZbIsskD8QxPHpz4Q6BlAmzV3q1A%3D)___(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps.

After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

**I never thought I would get involved in politics. Still, after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation by running for the United States Congress.**

I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn't be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights.

[**Join me in the fight to save the future of America.** ](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dbc44d008e9548ee833d5d76f1a0a229&_e=6qvHUDsk9mnxHfMwg15zyrhfqrN-oVh8FNAIwsxu6HHYjs2EG3uETcOj5p33-s63ThUo8yEP_7IwkBHmG-FlsOP02grBEXE4nwELSD_tzFycivDyS0fUcBJinsnex4kpGSA0sDYYq68O5eiD9s8eV-6VG770U0NRdYiPSdl5m6tR3nuwhQhaWS34uEM9aWupKLFib-ZMuAiJXaplEHUC6prRrNsph3wSJw3tfT9VZwu_iTUIhrYaKUgEZu6shRrqLzoQv0bOIPC3jOzfOzm0asbLlo7k0zNrHXqU2bWfScc%3D)

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dbc44d008e9548ee833d5d76f1a0a229&_e=6qvHUDsk9mnxHfMwg15zyrhfqrN-oVh8FNAIwsxu6HHYjs2EG3uETcOj5p33-s63ThUo8yEP_7IwkBHmG-FlsOP02grBEXE4nwELSD_tzFycivDyS0fUcBJinsnex4kpGSA0sDYYq68O5eiD9s8eV0EQSsY3G3ke8gLCDGKvamx5_Fe28Mh5-HvCfM4T6TKLTKH54pOVwrMQdif-3elp8gttSV6W2LakbyN3tTRGVfKav1By9HdltK9XAct1j99_gaAYOTmpZ-LQZeZpoDFQvaos4n4PNEoYDVTAAgZ6Kwo%3D)

**This picture** is the number one reason I serve Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation.

Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day.

****_Nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and community here at home._

clean_body: I want to introduce myself and let you know why I'm running. Allow Me To Introduce Myself | Friend, ********Wesley Hunt here. I was born and raised in Houston, Texas. After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point. with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point) My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps. After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.). I never thought I would get involved in politics. Still, after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation by running for the United States Congress. I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn't be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights. This picture is the number one reason I serve Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation. Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day. **Nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and community here at home. | Thank you, Wesley Hunt Paid for by Hunt for Congress Military images and information do not imply endorsement by DOD [Department of Defense] or any service branch.____Don't want to receive our emails anymore? __

Hey Peter,
I know I’m not the only one who’s tired of seeing headlines about Nazis in Ohio.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240314-1?refcode=em20240314-1&amount=5&refcode2=461_587540_gZaYbS&akid=461%2E587540%2EgZaYbS)
**Hatred, bigotry, fascism, and white supremacy have no place in Ohio or anywhere in this country.**
That’s why I’m proud to support someone who is fighting back: one of our newly endorsed candidates, **Christine Cockley, who’s running for Ohio HD-6** in the Columbus area.
As a young, progressive Jewish leader, Christine does not take this problem lightly, and I trust her to do the work to root out this evil from her community.
[**We’re working to help Christine raise $10,000 before the primary on Tuesday. Please make a $5 contribution directly to her campaign now →**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240314-1?refcode=em20240314-1&amount=5&refcode2=461_587540_gZaYbS&akid=461%2E587540%2EgZaYbS)

At **28 years old** , Christine has already made a big impact in Columbus.
She **volunteers for a nonprofit** dedicated to reducing harm caused by excessive alcohol consumption, serves on the board of a local community garden, and works for YWCA Columbus, a nonprofit that **promotes education, housing, and social justice**. She also previously worked in the office of Senator Sherrod Brown.
As a young person herself, Christine understands the urgency behind some of the problems young folks are facing today. That’s why she’ll support efforts to:
* Make housing and childcare more affordable
* Invest in transportation infrastructure
* Keep our communities safe from gun violence
* Raise the minimum wage
* Strengthen labor rights

If we ever want to make progress on these important issues and more, we need to elect a government that better reflects the population — **and that starts at the state level with leaders like Christine.**
I know Christine will do a fantastic job representing Columbus in the Ohio State House, but we need your support to help her get there. We’ll be investing heavily to help candidates like Christine win in November, and everything we do is made possible by grassroots donors like you.

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38785%2E3422442%2E3_AD-G)
Hey Derek, Katie Porter here. In 2020 I started Truth to Power, an organization dedicated to electing leaders to Congress who reject corporate PAC money and fight to lower costs, protect the environment, and restore the nationwide right to an abortion.
Today, I’m asking you to split a donation between my organization, Truth to Power, and the Democrat running in CA-47, the district I currently represent in Congress. We must hold CA-47 if Democrats are going to flip the House blue. **[Can you split a donation today between Truth to Power and CA-47 Democratic nominee Dave Min?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240314?refcode=em20240314-38785&refcode2=38785_3422442_3_AD-G&akid=38785%2E3422442%2E3_AD-G)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240314?refcode=em20240314-38785&refcode2=38785_3422442_3_AD-G&akid=38785%2E3422442%2E3_AD-G)
I’ve been so proud to represent this district, which includes my hometown of Irvine and coastal Orange County cities like Newport Beach and Huntington Beach. But when I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, it meant I couldn’t simultaneously run for the U.S. House.
Dave Min, a state Senator who currently represents 80% of the congressional district, just advanced out of last week’s primary and now will face Republican Scott Baugh—the same corrupt, extremist Republican I won against in 2022.
**I’ve endorsed Dave Min because CA-47 deserves to be represented by a progressive Democrat for years to come.** Dave has done important work at the state level to improve the lives of Orange County families. He ended gun shows on California state property, has fought to end offshore oil drilling, passed critical protections for domestic violence survivors, and delivered billions of dollars in COVID-19 relief funds to small businesses. He’s proven he can win in Orange County while delivering a progressive agenda.
This is one of the country’s most important House races. **Republicans hold a tiny majority in the House, and so holding every competitive seat like this one is critical.** Anything you can give will help us ensure CA-47 stays blue.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240314?refcode=em20240314-38785&refcode2=38785_3422442_3_AD-G&akid=38785%2E3422442%2E3_AD-G)

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80973246/460979265/-1109429436?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-03-14_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDgxZDZhYi00MmUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5qdWW-wIEGW5dOBJpQFRc6Z3Vb9_Gzr2etg0lstOQc=)
_Roe v. Wade_ was decided when I was still in school, and this issue is personal to me. When I was in high school, my friend had an illegal abortion that, later in life, left her infertile.

Stories like these and others that I’ve heard from women well into their 80s and 90s went through prior to _Roe v. Wade_ highlight just one of the many dangers we run the risk of repeating now that states across the country have enacted strict, total bans on abortion.

We’ve already seen stories across the country of women having to travel hundreds of miles out of state to access lifesaving care due to extreme legislation, and as long as we don’t enact federal legislation to change it, this will remain the case.

**Women deserve the right to bodily autonomy, and we must do everything in our power to protect it. That starts with delivering a pro-choice majority in the House this November.**

Wade was decided when I was still in school, and this issue is personal to me. When I was in high school, my friend had an illegal abortion that, later in life, left her infertile. Stories like these and others that I’ve heard from women well into their 80s and 90s went through prior to Roe v. Wade highlight just one of the many dangers we run the risk of repeating now that states across the country have enacted strict, total bans on abortion. We’ve already seen stories across the country of women having to travel hundreds of miles out of state to access lifesaving care due to extreme legislation, and as long as we don’t enact federal legislation to change it, this will remain the case. Women deserve the right to bodily autonomy, and we must do everything in our power to protect it. #
Friends -
$5.
That's the contribution I am asking you to make to The Long Run today. Let me quickly explain why:
At the end of March, we face an all-important end-of-quarter deadline for our movement — the first of the election year and one of the last chances we will have to make critical budget decisions on which races we can continue supporting.
Tomorrow marks the midpoint of this month and the honest truth is we have been pacing behind. So we are going to need a lot of support to reach that number tomorrow.
With Primary elections well underway and the General election quickly approaching, it has never been more crucial that we have the resources we need to help candidates that will take back the House majority and keep the Senate. And the only way we can do that is if we stay on track to hit our goals.
We have a lot of lost ground to make up, so I am counting on you to contribute $5 to help us get there.

clean_body: Friend... | Hello... This could be the last email I ever send you, Friend. But I have to be honest with you -- no matter how weary I am about opening up. Right now, the odds are stacked against us, and I need to know how you 'll react to this email to understand how to move forward. Your response could change everything. My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress. I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls. Now, I am also a Senate candidate in a crucial race in Indiana. The outcome of this election will determine if we can take back the Senate. Joe Biden and his Leftist collaborators are pouring millions into key races across the country in an effort to wipe out GOP candidates. But I won't let them win so easily. I'm not usually the type of person to ask for help, but there's no way I can make it on my own. The Democrats are attacking us from ALL angles because they hate what we stand for: freedom and American pride. | Friend, I'm not an establishment politician who will play games with the American people. I am a Patriot who wants to save America for the next generation. That's why I'm being so candid with you today. I'm not going to make false promises and tell you I can fix our country overnight. But I can promise you that I will make it my mission to restore faith in our government and put the American people before political deals. I intend to make you proud. _I 'm no stranger to a bit of hard work, Peter._

**A new report from the Texas American Federation of Teachers shows that 70% of Texas educators say they’re ready to leave the profession.**
That alarming statistic underscores just how bad the teaching crisis in Texas has become. Since the 2012 school year, around 10% of Texas teachers have left the field each year—citing low wages, poor benefits, unmanageable workloads, and political debates putting their classrooms in the middle of Republicans officials’ culture wars.

Hey Peter, did you catch Michelle on MSNBC last weekend? She joined during primetime on the show Ayman to talk about how extreme far-right and Democratic Latinas are both running for office as the Tejano vote continues to grow — and splinters — when it comes to issues like immigration and reproductive rights. = = Michelle was able to talk about issues that community members — both Democrats and Republicans — have been concerned about including ensuring their families had access to healthcare and that women had access to reproductive care with the right to choose. We continue to watch Monica bring this district back in time with her outdated and harmful voting when it comes to issues like abortion. Monica believes that she understands this district and South Texas with these decisions — but she couldn’t be more wrong. Michelle has spent the time talking with members of communities across the district — including her own family — and folks have made it clear: they WANT the right for women to choose what happens to their own body and to leave those conversations to doctors, not politicians. When asked during the interview how far-right MAGA Latinas like Monica were able to win in the last cycle, Michelle stressed this critical point: there were folks who didn’t have access to the polls or little to no information to vote. That’s why between now and November we have the critical job of getting as many people as we can in TX-15 the resources to vote and making sure they know what a leader like Michelle can do for their family and community. We know if we can do that, then we can WIN.= ¡Vamos por Quince! **Giffords, one of the most powerful groups in the fight against gun violence, just officially endorsed Greg for re-election!** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80976111/460988950/-1494636936?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.03.14_b1_tghq_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2ViZGFkNS00YmUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G-4v1_PZeHgZElaLG0U9WwsCdqdYsKf7gBY7euA5KZQ=) We’re thrilled to have the support of Gabby Giffords in this race, team.

Here in OH-01, Greg knows that thoughts and prayers just aren’t enough to address our nation’s gun violence epidemic.

He knows that, as a member of Congress, he can’t sit by and do nothing while mass shootings continue to plague the country.

And he knows that MAGA Republicans are standing in the way of our progress at each and every turn.

Friend,

It sounds crazy, but we're STILL falling behind on the fundraising front. The Democrats are surpassing all of their fundraising goals. Wealthy donors and corporations are spending boatloads of money to try and BUY the Senate and White House in 2024.

Last month, we fell short of our goal to keep pace with the Democrats. We don't have any choice but to make up for it in the month of March.

The closer the election gets, the more urgent our time becomes. Our country can not take 4 more years of President Biden or two more seconds of a Democrat majority in the Senate.

**Without[your support](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=3bc4513dd9244e23a3ee28066ab7af89&_e=ztC6KG97EXi3F7a7fClWRcOc7TkL4wuCYSslJy4q0lZn_uh3KEgHpf4VBknVYqHhVqkoE_YwmAFgjG93GTG4g48JrkkqUHepkvFWprqO1WWxjhhv08fZicQjUG8nKiDg4DydR3k1EWNdh8rLp5I3mHOSoZ8J1ZH7ao6L3c9qpspRNMj63SAxRQL_X7uFkjxuhDcBrmRjHN4CdVw40qZGh6GOqjkSMMN3VND_P-Piiwde8zkdRi3MCiUvwedj1ULUaRlXwS5PzOuVpIkNZdhI3IdYbFVChrP6cIoTHwjLnw4%3D), you can forget about any chance at a Republican majority this November to get America back on the right track.**

We are counting on grassroots patriots like you to fuel our great comeback.

_**Matt Dolan Surges to Lead in Final Poll Before Election Day**_
* Matt Dolan has surged into the leading position among the three Ohio Republican Primary candidates, according to the latest [Emerson College poll](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=9187a81768364f4fac9b16165011763d&_e=WvWPaqN3Yt5ND1lQovJrLA0EWcRGAbh4ARlya9UaifSLeWllUS9f_OuhlbEZB6lRIUu5ZCUGkdxFKIBEriv-wiq2TQWVPZY7UjQ4xXjpEZ5QoLPVRtluYXXd9Mci0HrEtWIIadvXyjH9Zxi2juY_m6pWlcZTiWEoMuTGa8vkbsZnKnlZ-DLdoKZl0CgAAP3V_RFu1bTDTwTts16vi4Ttb1e6Flbja0HbZNpY0XA1_5L-7ubZ_qJqr1-78-XxiaMer3bYQRjDoYOXOe3oQCCg5fhuApINgtj_ycU7gXgylOAtW4ZMoDJ7NkdM7frPBN7o) released this week.

* Matt Dolan has gained 11 points since the last Emerson poll in January, while support for his opponents has remained stagnant or even declined. Matt Dolan also remains the candidate best positioned to defeat Sherrod Brown.

_**Governor Mike DeWine and First Lady Fran DeWine Endorse Matt Dolan for US Senate.**_
* Matt Dolan’s campaign continued gaining momentum by **[earning the endorsement of Governor Mike DeWine and First Lady Fran DeWine](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=9187a81768364f4fac9b16165011763d&_e=WvWPaqN3Yt5ND1lQovJrLLet0IIbphPFjHWi9Yu5sGhV8atrlGpb-oaZom7tETcXiYFX8o-Ju_pJfGb8oMAUESNGRJ4NnJU7ymR4iUkJm5zBLgE-IRRItKoZSaCbPYZHnFPwJFlznwJVof5fBT_eC1H-5q6tovs16vY2ExT7s1hr2ELzhRmK9ZLW9typrB7c1HRYF0tg7px1m1J0ixE7ahiiO_9Pr4NildbDK8ROfAOSokD8cQqitGLIrqtHXAKnCVcsYOxzGMoXtxdiumSvc21PK8AP7ds37D8JV4tcal-NPSe-cWAQcwbrF1SOJKUE).

**
* “I am honored to have the support of the Governor and First Lady. For more than four decades, they have personified servant leadership on behalf of Ohio and showed what it takes to win tough races. As Ohio’s next U.S. Senator, I look forward to working with Governor DeWine and Republican leaders across the state to deliver results for Ohio and build a stronger, safer nation,” said Matt Dolan.
**
**

_“Gov. Mike DeWine endorsed Matt Dolan in Ohio’s U.S. Senate race on Monday, a surprise decision by the governor to wade into a competitive Republican primary. In a letter released Monday, the governor and First Lady Fran DeWine said Dolan is a “proven conservative” who helped bring jobs to Ohio...DeWine boasts deep political ties as the state’s top Republican, which could give Dolan an edge in the final days of the race.”_

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election years in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my mid-month goal would be sending****a crystal clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.****[_So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. to help me continue our fight for progress in this year? clean_body: I'm counting on your help to make up the gap | | | Friend, I wanted to reach out to personally thank you. I have so much to thank you for, so this message is a bit longer than usual. But in case you're short on time, I have to make sure that you see this first: My mid-month deadline is approaching, and we're still pacing dangerously short of my $100,000 goal.= | | = If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins. In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible. I alsoreleased my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability. From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen. I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom. Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve. There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election years in recent memory. Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. Missing my mid-month goal would be sending**a crystal clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you again for all that you do. I'm so grateful to have you on my team as we head into March. With love, Kirsten | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

Hello Fellow Democrats of West Virginia!
Dear WV Democrat,
Democratic County Conventions will be occurring this Saturday, March 16th all across the state. You are invited and encouraged to attend and to participate in your county convention.
What is a County Convention? A County Convention happens once every 4 years and the purpose is to elect delegates and standing committee members to the State Democratic Convention. The County Convention participants can also consider proposals for amendments to the State Platform and consider resolutions. Overall, county conventions are a great opportunity for Democrats within a county to meet and discuss issues that are important to them!
The State Convention elects delegates to the National Democratic Convention, elects Presidential Electors and adopts the WV Democratic Party Platform. The WV State Democratic Convention will be June 14-15 at the Charleston Civic Center.

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Heading to our next debate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Daniels For Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
Debate season is here in PA-10! I’m sending this note as I head to the next opportunity to talk to the voters of the district about my values and hear directly from them as to what they’re looking for in their next Member of Congress.
It's been a busy time. We’ve had several candidate forums in Dauphin, Cumberland, and York Counties and a live television debate on ABC27. It has been so exciting for me to have these frank and productive conversations and answer questions from the voters who will choose our Democratic nominee in PA-10. I firmly believe that in a democracy like ours, public officials need to be accessible and accountable to their voters.
There are more debates ahead and our campaign is beginning our GOTV program. Can you chip in $50, $25, or whatever you can afford to help us as we head into the last 6 weeks of the primary election? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
As these debates continue, one thing is clear. As an attorney, local activist, and Harrisburg City Councilwoman, I am the only Democrat running with the experience and values you can trust to take on Scott Perry . I’ll be ready on Day 1 to hit the ground running and fight for the issues that the voters of PA-10 care about.
The upcoming elections in PA-10 and across the country hold immense significance. To ensure women's reproductive freedom, safeguard and strengthen our democracy, combat inflation, and provide relief to American families, we need to elect genuine Democratic candidates who share our values and have a proven track record of standing up for them. In Congress, I’ll do just that. The stakes are high, and we must choose wisely.
My record speaks for itself. I haven’t backed down from our values and my record when debating my fellow Democratic candidates, and I won’t back down in Congress.
Can you make a contribution today to help elect a Democrat who won’t back down? Click here to donate now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With gratitude,
Shamaine

name: OcasioCortez.com
subject: AOC’s newest bill
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
How we answer these questions is going to shape how all of us live as a society for decades
#
_Content warning: this email discusses online harassment via digital forgeries of pornography._
As AI technology sharpens, deepfake images and videos have become more realistic — and more commonplace — in our daily lives.
Studies show that nearly 96% of deepfake videos contain pornographic imagery of women — **all of which is created non-consensually**.1
So Alexandria worked closely with abuse survivors to introduce the Disrupt Explicit Forged Images and Non-Consensual Edits (DEFIANCE) Act of 2024. If passed, victims could sue anyone who ‘knew or recklessly disregarded’ their consent when they created, shared, or received the deepfake pornography.
Alexandria put it simply: “How we answer these questions is going to shape how all of us live as a society for decades.”
[Alexandria came to Congress to legislate in a new way: by really centering everyday people and the policies that benefit their lives. If you can, will you contribute $5 today so that she can stay in Congress to keep working for working people and not special interests? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240314.nQFrUt&refcode=em20240314-5998-P_FND_EXP_HDL&t=1&akid=5998%2E2526796%2Ei7hzSo)
The DEFIANCE Act would amend the Violence Against Women Act, and has been endorsed by more than 20 organizations, including the National Women’s Law Center, the National Domestic Violence Hotline, and the Sexual Violence Prevention Association.
Just last month, Alexandria was named to the bipartisan House Task Force on Artificial Intelligence, where she will work to optimize AI innovation, while protecting the country from emerging threats in the new technology.
**Alexandria has been the target of disturbing online harassment for years, but isn’t afraid to hold those causing harm to account.**
[Will you contribute $5 today to power her campaign for progress? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240314.nQFrUt&refcode=em20240314-5998-P_FND_EXP_HDL&t=2&akid=5998%2E2526796%2Ei7hzSo)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240314.nQFrUt&refcode=em20240314-5998-P_FND_EXP_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5998%2E2526796%2Ei7hzSo)**
Whether or not you can donate today, thank you for standing with this movement.
In solidarity,
Team AOC
1 - [**Rolling Stone** : AOC’s Plan to End Deepfake Porn](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/23116?t=22&akid=5998%2E2526796%2Ei7hzSo)

Hey there -- we're writing to ask you to make an $8 donation today to support Elissa Slotkin’s campaign for Senate in Michigan.
Why $8? Because that’s the cost of a 6-pack of Michigan’s famous Vernors Ginger Ale -- one of the most quintessential Michigan staples known to all residents of our great state. We drink it at barbecues, at the game, and when our kids have a stomach ache.
The truth is that as strange as it sounds, these small dollar donations really do matter. It takes a village to elect a leader like Elissa to the Senate, and it’s so important that we maintain a steady pace of support.
With public polling showing our race in a dead heat, we have to be prepared to match our Republican opponent dollar-for-dollar so we can defend this open seat and protect our slim Democratic Senate majority.
We know that $8 may not sound like a lot on its own. But trust us that we wouldn’t keep asking if it didn’t add up when there are hundreds of people chipping in and showing their support. It’s how we’ve won our past campaigns and it’s how we plan to keep up the momentum to win this race too.
[**If you are able, will you make an $8 contribution to our campaign for Senate today? It’s not as much about how much you give, but how many people are coming together to show their support for Elissa and this campaign.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/1405?c0=ebs-em-mar24.tKbv-j&refcode=em240314-2-700&t=2&akid=1215%2E135344%2Ex2yY9c)**

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=33dba500cf4342f0b239ff3bab87abd1&_e=m0bUtfo1b3DRAaCkZ_BBONbeud83mK-C_VUMHcJfLPi4dzQ1ayRWtXXMsZACBJL0DAcSsHIZu-g2KGjfqp5zUyqYh6S9PMHnNnneMcmQ8y6QMPOWGwmFwjEonNCGtKTLzT4F5NckKMjWb-d6GazlRC-vpaxLPH84AVjBsCHdfY-j7unxnk5JPbb0l3Q2Cu6eHfvUoABJ2N6S-FQoegzyx9lbP5JZjP81g9kq55jqfdCtXzCfcQjFEkbpJwluLKL5N-A9_esxxrvC94XQgWzOHOgzW2mIS9pHo_7k4D7OKTqUlX8MbEcA377S8YT54cLSE4jovCMSe8pSP1OmBiKLoSDZI3jzsidmxfqf3BiQpNvBNGsl0pg1Xt6NqmjyKmA_pD_mMmpy_QfTbaauHkopsk4s7ME6ABCjMN3YQxXQvBI%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. ---
Right now, 1.6 million American children are enrolled in Catholic schools, and the school system they love is under threat of extinction because some states don't allow their parents to direct education tax dollars to their child's school.

**This isn't just the loss of an American institution. This is the withering of educational options in our most at-risk neighborhoods. **

_Because these schools aren't just for Catholics._

There's a beautiful phrase you will hear from Catholic educators: "We don't teach these kids because _they're_ Catholic. We teach because _we're_ Catholic."

Unlike what you might have heard about private schools, Catholic schools don't just open where there is existing parent wealth. As a charitable work, they open where there is a **need** for a quality education option, no matter what.

**In fact, many of these schools are the only other option for parents in areas with failing public schools. We believe those families deserve that alternative which is why we're fighting for school choice.**
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION:**
**LET PARENTS CHOOSE CATHOLIC SCHOOLS**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a962aaac8c4e4ab49ddb9fd33dcc2016&_e=jaV63xfVQIl5mKv8YDQapgnd6X-orwqPS8ES3VhiTtZhrJjV5I0tDFzgtcIG-3OTO_VUDXeo-Bkzg2EN4QdnK9Ws_cq3Hzr0nr9Iz_ksKw6gPjrWQa3vsNnzyGBPZx2nsWFpV2y0CMIvWoLOnoVh9yXrBe4hC4FKA9I5nU1mzVlargkVylGr-2Nyksl777IMXosFuWNELrOPZhvzFV8tHtFB2QOsP1fHzE9w6towmsiomJNw9LM4La2GBYNIZwz4rsLs3M_G065NOCB25n_4OwPCFE5W-JcmSdjVugvGNq6dgfupMNI-EJgxv8rrsR3o3Jrnv_lwx5wyy6PrarJFvf_1RglBasP9jM9rP7AY3wts6IIsrKYVq1zojYUxQKQzuU8hFrmWD8FxxwAZgC6ANwkvllajdVTC-TVp0g7X9RT58xhHmDYQyskAOmR4nnykHDHz__vJtu8fobHQ8Z207A%3D%3D)
---
The **American Federation for Children Growth Fund** knows that education needs in America vary for every individual student. At AFCGF, we want to give every child the opportunity to have his or her education needs met.

Whether that's a Catholic school or another type of school, we won’t have these diverse options unless we let families choose. [**Join us today in fighting for this vital American institution by signing our petition asking lawmakers to let parents choose Catholic schools.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a962aaac8c4e4ab49ddb9fd33dcc2016&_e=jaV63xfVQIl5mKv8YDQapgnd6X-orwqPS8ES3VhiTtZhrJjV5I0tDFzgtcIG-3OTO_VUDXeo-Bkzg2EN4QdnK9Ws_cq3Hzr0nr9Iz_ksKw6gPjrWQa3vsNnzyGBPZx2nsWFpV2y0CMIvWoLOnoVh9yXrBe4hC4FKA9I5nU1mzVlargkVylGr-2Nyksl777IMXosFuWNELrOPZhvzFV8tHtFB2QOsP1fHzE9w6towmsiomJNw9LM4La2GBYNIZwz4rsLs3M_G065NOCB25n_4OwPCFE5W-JcmSdjVugvGNq6dgfupMNI-EJgxv8rrsR3o6Z1ndyUWwUx1hbiazyo3_UbQs3BMHjp_2Ae1zSts1ICodnOmZgGih3o7Ra1AkVq9HrMDsevaL1YqhiPEUkDjWSZRDBuOIGHwiZ21kBp8c8HIdhPFlbX5slj9w4-gOPCy1yVA1PzPBRYC3PcnZ3ww2Q%3D%3D)

subject: RE: Keep us on the air
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Hey, Peter.
We’re just reaching out to make sure you saw Ruben’s email from earlier today.
If we’re going to win this November and defeat Kari Lake, we really need your help. We’re up on TV with our first ad of the race, and it’s going to take a TON of resources to keep that ad up.
And staying up keeps us competitive. And staying competitive here is how we’re going to take back the lead and win in Arizona. And winning in Arizona is how we’re going to hold the Senate.
So please, if you can:
[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruben-em-ad24?noskip=true&refcode=em240314-2-160&refcode2=2073_734936_nwzTZP&akid=2073%2E734936%2EnwzTZP)
* * *

Peter, these campaigns are full of decisions.
I don’t have to tell you that we’re up against Kari Lake right now. She ran a full statewide campaign in 2022, she’s got the endorsement of Trump, millions of MAGA followers nationwide. You name it — everybody knows her.
Me, I’m a Congressman... a big job in my community, but I’ve never run for a statewide office. I don’t have billionaires or former presidents lining up to support me. And when I think about it I’m still just a dad, a husband, a Marine.
I know that if we’re going to win, I have to make sure that all of Arizona knows my story and what I stand for.
[**That’s why we decided to put up our first TV ad of the cycle, Lucky Lima. You can watch it here.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruben-em-ad24?noskip=true&refcode=em240314-2-160&refcode2=2073_734936_nwzTZP&akid=2073%2E734936%2EnwzTZP)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruben-em-ad24?noskip=true&refcode=em240314-2-160&refcode2=2073_734936_nwzTZP&akid=2073%2E734936%2EnwzTZP)
Here’s the thing, though... once you go up on TV, you can’t come back down. We have to keep this up if our strategy is going to work. And we’ve still got about eight months until Election Day.
That’s why going up this early was such a tough decision. But we decided to do it because this team has always had my back, and it’s why I’m writing to you now.
We’ve got millions of dollars to raise to pay for these ads. To win this race. To hold the Senate, and to help defeat Trump in Arizona.
I know a donation of $20 seems like a drop in the bucket compared to what we need to raise, but I also know that if everybody reading this right now chipped in we’d absolutely destroy our fundraising goals.
Not everybody donates, though. And that’s why I’m counting on you.
[**Please, if you can afford it, make your first online donation today. It could be for anything — $20 would be great, but any amount helps. And it all adds up.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruben-em-ad24?noskip=true&refcode=em240314-2-160&refcode2=2073_734936_nwzTZP&akid=2073%2E734936%2EnwzTZP)

subject: The team that will win in Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.
| Friend, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.

I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.

One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.

And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.

I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.

[Please, split a $10 or $20 donation between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign. Whatever you can afford can help us build the team that’s going to win in Arizona. That’s why our work has never been more important than it is right now, and why we’re counting on patriots like you. My name is Harmeet Dhillon, and I founded the Center for American Liberty to fight for our freedoms, fight for our families, and fight for our futures. Our not-for-profit law firm is leading the charge defending parental rights and pioneering landmark litigation holding gender clinics accountable for performing “gender affirming care” on minors, because we know we can’t afford to lose this battle. clean_body: | | | | | Patriot, I knew this was coming. A sinister bill is making its way through the Illinois legislature... ...and if it passes, it’s only a matter of time before other states – blue, purple, and red alike – adopt this policy. Illinois House Bill 4876 would change the definition of “abused child” to include minors whose parents object to their children receiving puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, transgender surgeries, and abortions. It also conveniently shields doctors from liability if they prescribe these treatments to minors without parental consent. I know how this ends. Doctors coerced Layla Jane into a double mastectomy at 13 years old. Doctors coerced Chloe Cole into a double mastectomy at 15 years old. Doctors coerced Luka Hein into a double mastectomy at 16 years old. And all three regret the “gender affirming care” inflicted upon them. Now the state of Illinois wants to put thousands of kids in their position – but without the opportunity to later file a medical negligence lawsuit against predatory doctors. This is SICK. And worst of all, this bill gives the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) the power to remove children from their homes based on their new definition of an “abused child.” If this bill passes in Illinois, it’s only a matter of time before rabid leftists push for this in your state. That’s why our work has never been more important than it is right now, and why we’re counting on patriots like you. My name is Harmeet Dhillon, and I founded the Center for American Liberty to fight for our freedoms, fight for our families, and fight for our futures. Our not-for-profit law firm is leading the charge defending parental rights and pioneering landmark litigation holding gender clinics accountable for performing “gender affirming care” on minors, because we know we can’t afford to lose this battle. And we don’t charge the parents or de-transitioners we represent a DIME for our services. It’s only with the support of patriots like you that we’re able to pursue justice for our clients. The Left is willing to destroy our children, destroy our families and ultimately destroy our country if it means they get what they want. To them, the ends will always justify the means. We can’t change their minds by just showing them studies or sharing heartbreaking testimonies from heroes like Chloe Cole, Layla Jane, Luka Hein, Aurora Regino or Jessica Konen. The only way they’ll stop is if we beat them in court and make it so expensive to participate in this madness that doctors, teachers, and politicians become afraid to even think of transitioning children. Illinois law already classifies child abuse as a criminal offense ranging from a misdemeanor that carries a maximum sentence of one year in prison and a $2,500 fine to a felony that can carry up to $25,000 in fines and 15 years behind bars. No concerned parent should risk prison time for doing right by their own children. If you agree, I hope the Center for American Liberty can count on your support. | | | | | | | Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon Founder & CEO | | | | | P.S. It’s not child abuse for a parent to refuse to transition their child. It’s child abuse for doctors to lie to kids about the risks and long-term effects of “changing their gender,” it’s child abuse for the State to rip children from loving homes to enforce their ideology, and it’s child abuse for teachers to encourage kids to change their identities and hide it from their parents.
